7.7.20.j.d: तस्याः कर्णे विशाखे वा हिरण्यं निधाय घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी आपृणेथाम्̐ स्वाहा \\ इति स्रुवेणाभिजुहोति ।
7.7.20.j.m: Having placed a piece of gold in its ear or fork, he pours an offering upon it with the dipping-spoon, [saying,] "May heaven and earth be filled with ghee, svāhā!"

7.7.20.k.m: He causes [the ghee] to flow down to the root.

7.7.20.l.m: They erect pillars corresponding in measure to the sacrificer's height, as the tallest ones, properly.

7.7.20.m.m: Around it, he erects [pillars] navel-high, facing toward the post of udumbara wood.

7.7.20.n.s: nīcaiḥ sado vṛṣṭikāmasya minuyād uccair avṛṣṭikāmasya viparītam eke samāmananti /
7.7.20.n.d: नीचैः सदो वृष्टिकामस्य मिनुयाद् उच्चैर् अवृष्टिकामस्य विपरीतम् एके समामनन्ति ।
7.7.20.n.m: He should erect the sadas low for one desiring rain; high for one not desiring rain; some tradition states the reverse.

7.7.20.p.s: udīco vam̐śān ādhāya prāco vam̐śān ādadhāti /
7.7.20.p.d: उदीचो वम्̐शान् आधाय प्राचो वम्̐शान् आदधाति ।
7.7.20.p.m: Having placed the northward-pointing beams, he places the eastward-pointing beams.

7.7.20.q.s: aindram asi \\ iti trīṇi madhyamāni chadīm̐ṣy udañci nidadhāti /
7.7.20.q.d: ऐन्द्रम् असि \\ इति त्रीणि मध्यमानि छदीम्̐ष्य् उदञ्चि निदधाति ।
7.7.20.q.m: [With the mantra,] "You belong to Indra," he lays down the three middle roof-mats pointing northward.

7.7.20.r.s: indrasya sado 'si \\ iti trīṇi dakṣiṇāni viśvajanasya chāyā \\ iti trīṇy uttarāṇi /
7.7.20.r.d: इन्द्रस्य सदो ऽसि \\ इति त्रीणि दक्षिणानि विश्वजनस्य छाया \\ इति त्रीण्य् उत्तराणि ।
7.7.20.r.m: [With the mantra,] "You are Indra's seat," [he lays down] the three southern ones; [with] "The shelter of all people," the three northern ones.

7.7.20.s.m: He places the southern ones [first, then] the northern ones, facing toward the post of udumbara wood.

7.7.20.t.s: navachadi tejaskāmasya minuyād iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni chadīm̐ṣi teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
7.7.20.t.d: नवछदि तेजस्कामस्य मिनुयाद् इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि छदीम्̐षि तेषां याथाकामी ।
7.7.20.t.m: "He should erect [a sadas] of nine roof-mats for one desiring spiritual luster"—these optional roof-mats are explained in the Brāhmaṇa; one may choose among them as one desires.

7.7.20.u.s: aindram asi \\ indrāya tvā \\ iti saṃmitam abhimṛśataḥ /
7.7.20.u.d: ऐन्द्रम् असि \\ इन्द्राय त्वा \\ इति संमितम् अभिमृशतः ।
7.7.20.u.m: [With the mantra,] "You belong to Indra... for Indra, you..." the two [adhvaryu and sacrificer] touch the constructed [sadas].

7.7.20.v.m: [The same occurs for] the eastern hall and for the two carts of soma oblation.

7.7.21.b.s: nāsam̐sthite some 'dhvaryuḥ pūrveṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśyāpareṇa niṣkrāmed yadi niṣkrāmet \\ idaṃ viṣṇur vicakrame \\ iti japet /
7.7.21.b.d: नासम्̐स्थिते सोमे ऽध्वर्युः पूर्वेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने प्रविश्यापरेण निष्क्रामेद् यदि निष्क्रामेत् \\ इदं विष्णुर् विचक्रमे \\ इति जपेत् ।
7.7.21.b.m: Before the soma [sacrifice] is concluded, the adhvaryu should not enter through the eastern door of the shed of the soma carts and exit through the western; if he should exit, he should murmur: "This Viṣṇu strode across..."

7.7.21.c.s: nāpareṇa sadaḥ praviśya pūrveṇa niṣkrāmed yadi niṣkrāmet \\ uttiṣṭhann ojasā saha \\ iti japet /
7.7.21.c.d: नापरेण सदः प्रविश्य पूर्वेण निष्क्रामेद् यदि निष्क्रामेत् \\ उत्तिष्ठन्न् ओजसा सह \\ इति जपेत् ।
7.7.21.c.m: He should not enter the sadas through the western [door] and exit through the eastern; if he should exit, he should murmur: "Rising with strength..."

7.7.21.d.m: Here, some teachers prescribe the rite of the sounding-holes.

7.7.21.e.s: cātvālāt purīṣam āhṛtya dhiṣṇiyān nivapati caturaśrān parimaṇḍalān vā /
7.7.21.e.d: चात्वालात् पुरीषम् आहृत्य धिष्णियान् निवपति चतुरश्रान् परिमण्डलान् वा ।
7.7.21.e.m: Having fetched earth from the rubbish heap, he heaps up the hearth mounds, four-cornered or circular.

7.7.21.f.s: vibhūr asi \\ ity āgnīdhrīyam āgnīdhrāgāre yathottareṇāntarvedi saṃcaro bhavati /
7.7.21.f.d: विभूर् असि \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रीयम् आग्नीध्रागारे यथोत्तरेणान्तर्वेदि संचरो भवति ।
7.7.21.f.m: [With the mantra,] "You are wide-reaching..." [he heaps up] the āgnīdhra hearth in the āgnīdhra shed, in such a way that there is a pathway to the north inside the altar.

7.7.21.h.s: vahnir asi \\ ity apareṇa sadobilaṃ pṛṣṭhyāyāṃ prakrame hotrīyam /
7.7.21.h.d: वह्निर् असि \\ इत्य् अपरेण सदोबिलं पृष्ठ्यायां प्रक्रमे होत्रीयम् ।
7.7.21.h.m: With "You are the bearer...", [he piles] the dhiṣṇiya of the hotṛ west of the entrance of the sadas on the spine, at the distance of one pace.

7.7.21.i.d: श्वात्रो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणेन होत्रीयं मैत्रावरुणस्य ।
7.7.21.i.m: With "You are invigorating...", [he piles the dhiṣṇiya] of the maitrāvaruṇa to the south of the hotṛ's [dhiṣṇiya].

7.7.21.j.m: To the north of the hotṛ's [dhiṣṇiya], [he piles] the others extending toward the north:

7.7.21.k.s: tutho 'si \\ iti brāhmaṇāccham̐sinas \\ uśig asi \\ iti potur andhārir asi \\ iti neṣṭur avasyur asi \\ ity acchāvākasya pratikṛṣṭataram /
7.7.21.k.d: तुथो ऽसि \\ इति ब्राह्मणाच्छम्̐सिनस् \\ उशिग् असि \\ इति पोतुर् अन्धारिर् असि \\ इति नेष्टुर् अवस्युर् असि \\ इत्य् अच्छावाकस्य प्रतिकृष्टतरम् ।
7.7.21.k.m: With "You are Tutha...", [the dhiṣṇiya] of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin; with "You are eager...", of the potṛ; with "You are the enemy of blindness...", of the neṣṭṛ; with "You are seeking favor...", of the acchāvāka, placed somewhat further back.

7.7.21.l.s: śundhyūr asi \\ iti mārjālīyaṃ bahiḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdhe vedeḥ samam āgnīdhrīyeṇa yathā dakṣiṇenāntarvedi saṃcaro bhavati /
7.7.21.l.d: शुन्ध्यूर् असि \\ इति मार्जालीयं बहिःसदसं दक्षिणार्धे वेदेः समम् आग्नीध्रीयेण यथा दक्षिणेनान्तर्वेदि संचरो भवति ।
7.7.21.l.m: With "You are cleansing...", [he piles] the mārjālīya outside the sadas in the southern half of the vedi, level with the āgnīdhra [fire-hearth], so that there is a passage inside the vedi to the south.

7.7.21.m.m: To each [formula] he attaches [the phrase]: "...the face of Rudra."

7.7.21.n.m: Here some [teachers] prescribe the strewing of the vedi.

7.7.21.o.s: uttaravediṃ kharam uparavān dhiṣṇiyām̐ś ca na stṛṇāti //
7.7.21.o.d: उत्तरवेदिं खरम् उपरवान् धिष्णियाम्̐श् च न स्तृणाति ॥
7.7.21.o.m: He does not strew the uttaravedi, the mound, the uparava holes, or the dhiṣṇiyas.

7.8.22.a.m: He sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the animal [sacrifice] for Agni and Soma.

7.8.22.b.m: Its procedure is explained by the independent animal sacrifice.

7.8.22.c.m: The Six-hotṛ [mantra] and the animal offering as subsidiary rites are not present.

7.8.22.d.m: Having fueled the fires, he ties the enclosing sticks of the hospitality offering onto the kindling wood.

7.8.22.e.s: agnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pāśukāni pātrāṇi prayunakti /
7.8.22.e.d: अग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थं पाशुकानि पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति ।
7.8.22.e.m: Having strewn around the fires, washed his hands, and strewn a row of reed grass, he sets out the utensils for the animal [sacrifice] as required.

7.8.22.f.s: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā pratihṛtya gārhapatye pāśukāny ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
7.8.22.f.d: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा प्रतिहृत्य गार्हपत्ये पाशुकान्य् आज्यानि गृह्णाति ।
7.8.22.f.m: Having performed whatever comes prior to scooping the clarified butter, he shifts [the vessels] and scoops the portions of clarified butter for the animal [sacrifice] at the gārhapatya fire.

7.8.22.g.s: evā vandasva \\ ity upasthe brahmā rājānaṃ kurute /
7.8.22.g.d: एवा वन्दस्व \\ इत्य् उपस्थे ब्रह्मा राजानं कुरुते ।
7.8.22.g.m: With "Thus praise...", the brahman priest takes King [Soma] onto his lap.

7.8.22.h.s: ādadate grāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśaṃ camasān ātithyābarhir idhmam ājyāny agnīṣomīyaṃ cānunayanti /
7.8.22.h.d: आददते ग्राव्णो वायव्यानि द्रोणकलशं चमसान् आतिथ्याबर्हिर् इध्मम् आज्यान्य् अग्नीषोमीयं चानुनयन्ति ।
7.8.22.h.m: They take up the pressing stones, the vāyavya cups, the wooden trough, the goblets, the sacrificial grass of the hospitality rite, the kindling wood, and the clarified butters, and bring along the animal for Agni and Soma.

7.8.22.i.s: ut patnīm ānayanty anv anām̐si pravartayanti /
7.8.22.i.d: उत् पत्नीम् आनयन्त्य् अन्व् अनाम्̐सि प्रवर्तयन्ति ।
7.8.22.i.m: They lead the sacrificer's wife forward; they roll the carts forward.

7.8.22.j.s: praitu brahmaṇas patnī \\ iti neṣṭā patnīm udānayati /
7.8.22.j.d: प्रैतु ब्रह्मणस् पत्नी \\ इति नेष्टा पत्नीम् उदानयति ।
7.8.22.j.m: With "May the wife of the priest go forth...", the neṣṭṛ leads the sacrificer's wife forward.

7.8.22.k.m: Being led forward, she mutters: "Then I, following desires...".

7.8.22.l.s: suprajasas tvā vayam ity apareṇa śālāmukhīyam upaviśya dārśapaurṇamāsikān mantrāñ japati /
7.8.22.l.d: सुप्रजसस् त्वा वयम् इत्य् अपरेण शालामुखीयम् उपविश्य दार्शपौर्णमासिकान् मन्त्राञ् जपति ।
7.8.22.l.m: Having sat down west of the śālāmukhīya fire with "May we, endowed with good offspring, [serve] you...", she mutters the mantras belonging to the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

7.8.22.m.d: शालामुखीयं गार्हपत्यकर्मभ्यो ऽन्ववस्यन्ति तस्मिन् गार्हपत्यकर्माणि क्रियन्ते ।
7.8.22.m.m: They allocate the śālāmukhīya fire for the rites of the gārhapatya; the rites of the gārhapatya are performed at it.

7.8.22.n.m: He gives the ritual direction: "Summon together those entitled to the rite!"

7.8.22.o.m: They summon them—the dependents of the sacrificer.

7.8.22.p.s: adhvaryuṃ yajamāno 'nvārabhate yajamānaṃ patnī patnīṃ yajamānasyāmātyāḥ /
7.8.22.p.d: अध्वर्युं यजमानो ऽन्वारभते यजमानं पत्नी पत्नीं यजमानस्यामात्याः ।
7.8.22.p.m: The sacrificer holds on from behind to the adhvaryu; the wife to the sacrificer; the dependents of the sacrificer to the wife.

7.8.22.q.s: tān ahatena vāsasā pracchādya pracaraṇyāṃ caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā pracchādanārthasya vāsaso daśāyām̐ hiraṇyaṃ baddhvājye 'vadhāya srugdaṇḍe vāsaso 'ntam upaniyamya śālāmukhīye vaisarjanau juhoti tvam̐ soma tanūkṛdbhyas \\ iti pūrvām āhutiṃ juhoti juṣāṇo aptur ājyasya vetu svāhā \\ iti dvitīyām /
7.8.22.q.d: तान् अहतेन वाससा प्रच्छाद्य प्रचरण्यां चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा प्रच्छादनार्थस्य वाससो दशायाम्̐ हिरण्यं बद्ध्वाज्ये ऽवधाय स्रुग्दण्डे वाससो ऽन्तम् उपनियम्य शालामुखीये वैसर्जनौ जुहोति त्वम्̐ सोम तनूकृद्भ्यस् \\ इति पूर्वाम् आहुतिं जुहोति जुषाणो अप्तुर् आज्यस्य वेतु स्वाहा \\ इति द्वितीयाम् ।
7.8.22.q.m: Having covered them with an unwashed garment, scooped four ladlings into the pracaraṇī ladle, tied gold into the fringe of the garment used for covering, placed it into the clarified butter, and fastened the edge of the garment to the ladle handle, he offers the two departure oblations in the śālāmukhīya fire: he offers the first oblation with "You, O Soma, to the body-makers...", and the second with "Enjoying, quick, may he partake of the clarified butter, svāhā."

7.8.22.s.s: śālāmukhīye 'gnipraṇayanāny ādīpayati sikatāś copayamanīr upakalpayata udyacchatīdhmam upayacchaty upayamanīr upayate dhāryamāṇe //
7.8.22.s.d: शालामुखीये ऽग्निप्रणयनान्य् आदीपयति सिकताश् चोपयमनीर् उपकल्पयत उद्यच्छतीध्मम् उपयच्छत्य् उपयमनीर् उपयते धार्यमाणे ॥
7.8.22.s.m: He kindles the embers for carrying forward the fire in the śālāmukhīya fire, prepares sand and supporting pans, lifts up the kindling wood, supports the pans, while the pan is held supported.

7.8.23.a.s: agnīṣomābhyāṃ praṇīyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati praṇīyamānābhyām anubrūhi \\ iti vā /
7.8.23.a.d: अग्नीषोमाभ्यां प्रणीयमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति प्रणीयमानाभ्याम् अनुब्रूहि \\ इति वा ।
7.8.23.a.m: He gives the ritual direction: "Recite for Agni and Soma being carried forward!", or "Recite for the two being carried forward!"

7.8.23.b.s: trir anūktāyām ayaṃ no agnis \\ ity agniprathamāḥ somaprathamā vā prāñco gacchanti /
7.8.23.b.d: त्रिर् अनूक्तायाम् अयं नो अग्निस् \\ इत्य् अग्निप्रथमाः सोमप्रथमा वा प्राञ्चो गच्छन्ति ।
7.8.23.b.m: When [the verse] has been recited three times, with "This fire of ours...", they proceed eastward, with the fire in front or with Soma in front.

7.8.23.c.m: They bring along [the utensils] as required.

7.8.23.e.m: They lead along the animal for Agni and Soma.

7.8.23.f.s: āgnīdhrīya etam agniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya \\ agne naya \\ iti nayavatyarcāgnīdhre juhoti /
7.8.23.f.d: आग्नीध्रीय एतम् अग्निं प्रतिष्ठाप्य \\ अग्ने नय \\ इति नयवत्यर्चाग्नीध्रे जुहोति ।
7.8.23.f.m: Having established this fire at the āgnīdhra [hearth], he offers in the āgnīdhra fire with a verse containing the root nī: "O Agni, lead...".

7.8.23.h.s: nidadhati grāvṇo vāyavyāni droṇakalaśaṃ camasāṃś ca /
7.8.23.h.d: निदधति ग्राव्णो वायव्यानि द्रोणकलशं चमसांश् च ।
7.8.23.h.m: They put down the pressing stones, the vāyavya cups, the wooden trough, and the goblets.

7.8.23.j.s: uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītya \\ uru viṣṇo vikramasva \\ ity auttaravedike juhoti /
7.8.23.j.d: उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्य \\ उरु विष्णो विक्रमस्व \\ इत्य् औत्तरवेदिके जुहोति ।
7.8.23.j.m: Having gone around the āgnīdhra dhiṣṇiya by the north, he offers on the uttaravedi fire with "Stride out wide, O Viṣṇu...".

7.8.23.k.m: The dependents return by the way they came.

7.8.23.l.s: somo jigāti gātuvit \\ iti saumyarcāpareṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne brahmā rājānaṃ prapādayati /
7.8.23.l.d: सोमो जिगाति गातुवित् \\ इति सौम्यर्चापरेण द्वारेण हविर्धाने ब्रह्मा राजानं प्रपादयति ।
7.8.23.l.m: With the verse addressed to Soma: "Soma goes forth, knowing the path...", the brahman priest causes King [Soma] to enter the cart-shed through the western door.

7.8.23.n.s: urv antarikṣam anvemi \\ iti pūrveṇādhvaryuḥ praviśya \\ adityāḥ sado 'si \\ iti dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya nīḍe kṛṣṇājinaṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti /
7.8.23.n.d: उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्वेमि \\ इति पूर्वेणाध्वर्युः प्रविश्य \\ अदित्याः सदो ऽसि \\ इति दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य नीडे कृष्णाजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति ।
7.8.23.n.m: Having entered through the eastern [door] with "I follow the wide intermediate space...", the adhvaryu spreads a black antelope skin with its neck to the east and hairy side upward inside the seat of the southern cart with "You are the seat of Aditi."

7.8.23.o.s: prattam̐ rājānam adityāḥ sada āsīda \\ iti tasminn āsādayati /
7.8.23.o.d: प्रत्तम्̐ राजानम् अदित्याः सद आसीद \\ इति तस्मिन्न् आसादयति ।
7.8.23.o.m: He sets King [Soma] down on it, having received him, with "Sit on the seat of Aditi!"

7.8.23.p.s: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantryedhmaṃ vediṃ ca prokṣya prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjyāpareṇottaravediṃ mantreṇa barhiḥ stṛṇāti yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ /
7.8.23.p.d: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्येध्मं वेदिं च प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्यापरेणोत्तरवेदिं मन्त्रेण बर्हिः स्तृणाति यथा दर्शपूर्णमासयोः ।
7.8.23.p.m: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters with mantras, addressed the brahman priest, sprinkled the kindling wood and the vedi, poured out the remnant of the sprinkling water, thrown the two purifiers into it, he strews the sacrificial grass west of the uttaravedi with the mantra, as at the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

7.8.23.q.m: When the clarified butters have been deposited, he proceeds with the measuring of the sacrificial post.

7.8.23.r.m: He dedicates the animal for Agni and Soma.

7.8.24.b.s: pravaraṃ pravṛtyāśrāvam ṛtupraiṣādibhiḥ saumikān ṛtvijo vṛṇīte /
7.8.24.b.d: प्रवरं प्रवृत्याश्रावम् ऋतुप्रैषादिभिः सौमिकान् ऋत्विजो वृणीते ।
7.8.24.b.m: Having chosen the ancestral invocation and caused [the āgnīdhra] to announce, he chooses the priests belonging to the soma sacrifice with the season-summonses and other [formulas].

7.8.24.c.s: indram̐ hotrāt sajūr diva ā pṛthivyās \\ iti hotāram /
7.8.24.c.d: इन्द्रम्̐ होत्रात् सजूर् दिव आ पृथिव्यास् \\ इति होतारम् ।
7.8.24.c.m: With "Indra from the hotṛ-office, together from heaven to earth...", [he chooses] the hotṛ.

7.8.24.d.m: Having cast a blade of grass without a wooden sword, he chooses the subsequent [priests]:

7.8.24.e.m: With "Agni from the āgnīdhra-office...", the āgnīdhra priest;

7.8.24.f.s: aśvinādhvaryū ādhvaryavāt \\ ity ātmānaṃ pratiprasthātāraṃ ca /
7.8.24.f.d: अश्विनाध्वर्यू आध्वर्यवात् \\ इत्य् आत्मानं प्रतिप्रस्थातारं च ।
7.8.24.f.m: With "The two Aśvins as adhvaryus from the adhvaryu-office...", himself and the pratiprasthātṛ;

7.8.24.g.m: With "Mitra and Varuṇa as directors from the director-office...", the maitrāvaruṇa;

7.8.24.h.m: With "Indra as brahman from the brāhmaṇa-office...", the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin;

7.8.24.i.m: With "The Maruts from the potṛ-office...", the potṛ;

7.8.24.j.m: With "The pressing stone from the neṣṭṛ-office...", the neṣṭṛ;

7.8.24.k.s: agnir devīnāṃ viśāṃ puraetāyam̐ sunvan yajamāno manuṣyāṇām \\ tayor asthūri gārhapatyaṃ dīdāya gacchatam̐ himā vā yu \ rādhām̐sīt saṃpṛñcānāv asaṃpṛñcānau tanvas \\ iti yajamānam /
7.8.24.k.d: अग्निर् देवीनां विशां पुरएतायम्̐ सुन्वन् यजमानो मनुष्याणाम् \\ तयोर् अस्थूरि गार्हपत्यं दीदाय गच्छतम्̐ हिमा वा यु \ राधाम्̐सीत् संपृञ्चानाव् असंपृञ्चानौ तन्वस् \\ इति यजमानम् ।
7.8.24.k.m: With "Agni, the leader of the divine clans, this pressing sacrificer of human [clans]; may their gārhapatya shine not singly; go, you two, during winters... uniting wealth, not uniting bodies", [he chooses] the sacrificer.

7.8.24.l.s: juṣṭo vāco bhūyāsam ity etābhyāṃ pravṛtaḥpravṛto juhoty anantaraṃ pravarāt /
7.8.24.l.d: जुष्टो वाचो भूयासम् इत्य् एताभ्यां प्रवृतःप्रवृतो जुहोत्य् अनन्तरं प्रवरात् ।
7.8.24.l.m: Each one, as he is chosen, immediately after the ancestral invocation, offers [an oblation] with these two [formulas]: "May I be acceptable to Speech...".

7.8.24.m.m: Having offered, the adhvaryu chooses the subsequent [priests].

7.8.24.n.m: Some [teachers] prescribe the ancestral invocations at the savanīya [animal sacrifice].

7.8.24.o.s: hutāyāṃ vapāyām \\ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati pitāputrīyā subrahmaṇyā bhavati /
7.8.24.o.d: हुतायां वपायाम् \\ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति पितापुत्रीया सुब्रह्मण्या भवति ।
7.8.24.o.m: When the omentum has been offered, he issues the direction: "Subrahmaṇya, call the Subrahmaṇyā litany!"; the Subrahmaṇyā litany includes the names of the father and son.

7.8.24.p.m: In the afternoon, he draws the vasatīvarī waters from flowing waters.

7.8.24.q.m: He should not go past the nearest flowing [waters].

7.8.24.r.m: [He draws them] at the junction of sunlight and shadow,

7.8.24.s.s: kūlasya vṛkṣasya svayaṃ vā chāyāṃ kṛtvā /
7.8.24.s.d: कूलस्य वृक्षस्य स्वयं वा छायां कृत्वा ।
7.8.24.s.m: having made a shadow by means of the bank, a tree, or himself.

7.8.24.t.s: haviṣmatīr imā āpas \\ iti pratīpaṃ tiṣṭhan kumbhaṃ kumbhīṃ vābhipūrayati /
7.8.24.t.d: हविष्मतीर् इमा आपस् \\ इति प्रतीपं तिष्ठन् कुम्भं कुम्भीं वाभिपूरयति ।
7.8.24.t.m: [With the mantra,] "These waters possessed of oblations..." standing facing upstream, he fills a pitcher or a small pitcher.

7.8.24.u.s: yady agṛhītāḥ sūryo 'bhinimroced yo brāhmaṇo bahuyājī tasya gṛhāt kumbhyānāṃ gṛhṇīyāt /
7.8.24.u.d: यद्य् अगृहीताः सूर्यो ऽभिनिम्रोचेद् यो ब्राह्मणो बहुयाजी तस्य गृहात् कुम्भ्यानां गृह्णीयात् ।
7.8.24.u.m: If the sun should set while they are not yet drawn, he should draw from the pitcher-water of a brāhmaṇa who has performed many sacrifices.

7.8.24.v.s: yadi taṃ na vindeyur agnim̐ hiraṇyaṃ cādāya pareyād yatrāpaḥ syus taj jyotir upariṣṭād dhārayan hiraṇyam antardhāya vare datte gṛhṇāti /
7.8.24.v.d: यदि तं न विन्देयुर् अग्निम्̐ हिरण्यं चादाय परेयाद् यत्रापः स्युस् तज् ज्योतिर् उपरिष्टाद् धारयन् हिरण्यम् अन्तर्धाय वरे दत्ते गृह्णाति ।
7.8.24.v.m: If they should not find such a one, he should go taking fire and gold to where there is water; holding the light above it and placing the gold in between, he draws [the water], after a gift of choice has been given.

7.8.24.w.s: agner vo 'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi \\ ity apareṇa śālāmukhīyam upasādayati /
7.8.24.w.d: अग्नेर् वो ऽपन्नगृहस्य सदसि सादयामि \\ इत्य् अपरेण शालामुखीयम् उपसादयति ।
7.8.24.w.m: [With the mantra,] "I seat you in the seat of Agni whose house is unfallen," he places [them] down to the west of the śālāmukhīya fire.

7.8.24.x.m: At sunset, he proceeds with the animal sacrificial framework beginning with the consultation.

7.8.24.y.s: tasya dakṣiṇena havirdhānam uttareṇa vā samavattaṃ pariharati /
7.8.24.y.d: तस्य दक्षिणेन हविर्धानम् उत्तरेण वा समवत्तं परिहरति ।
7.8.24.y.m: He carries the cut-off portions of that [animal] around to the south or to the north of the shed of the soma carts.

7.8.24.z.s: na yajamāno bhakṣān bhakṣayati bhakṣaṇam eke samānanti /
7.8.24.z.d: न यजमानो भक्षान् भक्षयति भक्षणम् एके समानन्ति ।
7.8.24.z.m: The sacrificer does not consume the portions; some teachers teach the consumption [by him].

7.8.25.a.m: the animal sacrifice to Agni-Soma is concluded.

7.8.25.b.s: niśāyāṃ vasatīvarīḥ pariharati sarvato na purastāt /
7.8.25.b.d: निशायां वसतीवरीः परिहरति सर्वतो न पुरस्तात् ।
7.8.25.b.m: At night he carries the Vasatīvarī waters all around, but not across the east.

7.8.25.c.s: utkrāmata \\ ity uktvāntarvedi yajamānaḥ patnī ca bhavataḥ /
7.8.25.c.d: उत्क्रामत \\ इत्य् उक्त्वान्तर्वेदि यजमानः पत्नी च भवतः ।
7.8.25.c.m: Having said, "Step out!", the sacrificer and the wife are within the vedi.

7.8.25.d.m: He does not carry them around one who has not been consecrated.

7.8.25.e.s: ādāya kumbham̐ savye 'm̐se 'tyādhāyāpareṇa prājahitam atikramya dakṣiṇayā dvāropanirhṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ vedyantam anu parihṛtya \\ indrāgniyor bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ iti dakṣiṇasyām uttaravediśroṇyām̐ sādayati /
7.8.25.e.d: आदाय कुम्भम्̐ सव्ये ऽम्̐से ऽत्याधायापरेण प्राजहितम् अतिक्रम्य दक्षिणया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्य दक्षिणं वेद्यन्तम् अनु परिहृत्य \\ इन्द्राग्नियोर् भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इति दक्षिणस्याम् उत्तरवेदिश्रोण्याम्̐ सादयति ।
7.8.25.e.m: Taking the pitcher, putting it upon his left shoulder, stepping past to the west of the prājahita [fire], carrying it out through the southern door, carrying it along the southern edge of the vedi, he deposits it on the southern hip of the uttaravedi with: "You are the portions of Indra and Agni."

7.8.25.f.s: ādāya kumbhaṃ dakṣiṇe 'm̐se 'tyādhāya yathetaṃ pratyetyottarapūrvayā dvāropanirhṛtyottaraṃ vedyantam anu parihṛtya mitrāvaruṇayor bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ ity uttarasyām uttaravediśroṇyām̐ sādayati /
7.8.25.f.d: आदाय कुम्भं दक्षिणे ऽम्̐से ऽत्याधाय यथेतं प्रत्येत्योत्तरपूर्वया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्योत्तरं वेद्यन्तम् अनु परिहृत्य मित्रावरुणयोर् भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्याम् उत्तरवेदिश्रोण्याम्̐ सादयति ।
7.8.25.f.m: Taking the pitcher, putting it upon his right shoulder, returning the way he came, carrying it out through the north-eastern door, carrying it along the northern edge of the vedi, he deposits it on the northern hip of the uttaravedi with: "You are the portions of Mitra and Varuṇa."

7.8.25.g.s: ādāya kumbham̐ savye 'm̐se 'tyādhāya tīrthena prapādya viśveṣāṃ vedānāṃ bhāgadheyīḥ stha \\ ity āgnīdhre sādayati /
7.8.25.g.d: आदाय कुम्भम्̐ सव्ये ऽम्̐से ऽत्याधाय तीर्थेन प्रपाद्य विश्वेषां वेदानां भागधेयीः स्थ \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रे सादयति ।
7.8.25.g.m: Taking the pitcher, putting it upon his left shoulder, entering through the tīrtha, he deposits it in the Āgnīdhra [shed] with: "You are the portions of all the Vedas."

7.8.25.i.s: subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \\ iti saṃpreṣyati pitāputrīyā subrahmaṇyā bhavati /
7.8.25.i.d: सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \\ इति संप्रेष्यति पितापुत्रीया सुब्रह्मण्या भवति ।
7.8.25.i.m: He issues the direction: "Subrahmaṇya, chant the Subrahmaṇyā [litanies]!"; it is the father-and-son Subrahmaṇyā.

7.8.25.j.s: yā yajamānasya vratadhuktām āśire duhrata yā patnyās tāṃ dadhigrahāya yā gharmadhuktāṃ dadhigharmāya taptam anātaṅkyaṃ payo maitrāvaruṇāya śṛtātaṅkyaṃ dadhy ādityagrahāya kurutāt \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
7.8.25.j.d: या यजमानस्य व्रतधुक्ताम् आशिरे दुह्रत या पत्न्यास् तां दधिग्रहाय या घर्मधुक्तां दधिघर्माय तप्तम् अनातङ्क्यं पयो मैत्रावरुणाय शृतातङ्क्यं दध्य् आदित्यग्रहाय कुरुतात् \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
7.8.25.j.m: He directs: "The milk-cow of the sacrificer that yields the vrata milk—milk her for the milk-mixture; the wife's, for the curd-cup; the gharmadhuk-cow, for the dadhigharma; prepare boiled, uncoagulated milk for the Maitrāvaruṇa [cup], and boiled, coagulated curd for the Āditya cup."

7.8.25.k.m: Adorned, the priests spend the night in the Āgnīdhra [shed].

7.8.25.l.m: In the eastern hall, they keep the wife awake.

7.8.25.m.m: In the havirdhāna [shed], the sacrificer guards King [Soma], guards [him].

8.1.1.b.s: tathā karmāṇy upakramante yathā purā vācaḥ pravaditoḥ prātaranuvāko bhavati /
8.1.1.b.d: तथा कर्माण्य् उपक्रमन्ते यथा पुरा वाचः प्रवदितोः प्रातरनुवाको भवति ।
8.1.1.b.m: They undertake the rites in such a way that the morning recitation takes place before speech is uttered [by birds].

8.1.1.c.s: prajāpatir manasāndho 'cchetas \\ iti trayastrim̐śataṃ yajñatanūr āgnīdhre juhoti /
8.1.1.c.d: प्रजापतिर् मनसान्धो ऽच्छेतस् \\ इति त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शतं यज्ञतनूर् आग्नीध्रे जुहोति ।
8.1.1.c.m: With: "Prajāpati, having an eye for the blind, with his mind...", he offers the thirty-three [oblations of the] sacrificial forms into the Āgnīdhra [fire].

8.1.1.d.m: Reciting each previous one and offering with each subsequent one, or indeed with only the first one,

8.1.1.e.m: he offers in case of a mishap in the sacrifice, according to some.

8.1.1.f.m: He sets in motion the sacrificial framework of the animal for the pressing day.

8.1.1.g.m: Its procedure has been explained by the independent animal sacrifice.

8.1.1.h.s: na barhir vidyate prastaram evāharati barhiṣaḥ kalpena /
8.1.1.h.d: न बर्हिर् विद्यते प्रस्तरम् एवाहरति बर्हिषः कल्पेन ।
8.1.1.h.m: There is no strew; he brings only the prastara according to the rule of the strew.

8.1.1.i.m: At the time of setting down the vessels, he sets out the pracaraṇī as the first offering ladle.

8.1.1.j.m: At the time of ladling clarified butter, having taken four portions in the pracaraṇī, he takes [clarified butter] in the subsequent [ladles].

8.1.1.k.s: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantryedhmaṃ vediṃ prastaraṃ ca prokṣya prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjya prastaram̐ sādayitvā srucaḥ sādayati /
8.1.1.k.d: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्येध्मं वेदिं प्रस्तरं च प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्य प्रस्तरम्̐ सादयित्वा स्रुचः सादयति ।
8.1.1.k.m: Having addressed the sprinkling waters, having addressed the brahman priest, having sprinkled the firewood, the vedi, and the prastara, having poured out the remainder of the sprinkling waters, having laid down the two strainers, having set down the prastara, he sets down the offering ladles.

8.1.1.l.s: ayaṃ no agnir varivaḥ kṛṇotu \\ ity āgnīdhram abhimṛśati /
8.1.1.l.d: अयं नो अग्निर् वरिवः कृणोतु \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रम् अभिमृशति ।
8.1.1.l.m: With: "May this Agni make room for us...", he touches the Āgnīdhra [fire/shed].

8.1.1.m.m: With: "Here Viṣṇu strode...", [he touches] the two havirdhāna [carts].

8.1.1.n.m: With: "O Agni, you purify our life-spans...", [he touches] the offering ladles.

8.1.1.o.m: With: "Come, O Vāyu, adorn...", [he touches] the Vāyavya cups.

8.1.1.p.m: With: "Arising with vigour...", [he touches] the sadas.

8.1.1.q.m: He sets out the vessels on the mound.

8.1.1.r.s: agnir devatā \ gāyatrī chandas \\ ity etair yathārūpam \\ kas tvā yunakti sa tvā yunaktu \\ ity avaśiṣṭāni /
8.1.1.r.d: अग्निर् देवता \ गायत्री छन्दस् \\ इत्य् एतैर् यथारूपम् \\ कस् त्वा युनक्ति स त्वा युनक्तु \\ इत्य् अवशिष्टानि ।
8.1.1.r.m: With: "Agni is the deity, the meter is Gāyatrī...", [he sets out] each according to its form; the remaining ones with: "Who yokes you? May he yoke you."

8.1.1.s.s: dakṣiṇe 'm̐sa upām̐śvantaryāmayoḥ pātre dakṣiṇam upām̐śor uttaram antaryāmasya /
8.1.1.s.d: दक्षिणे ऽम्̐स उपाम्̐श्वन्तर्यामयोः पात्रे दक्षिणम् उपाम्̐शोर् उत्तरम् अन्तर्यामस्य ।
8.1.1.s.m: At the southern shoulder, [he sets out] the two vessels of the Upāṃśu and Antaryāma [cups]—the southern for the Upāṃśu, the northern for the Antaryāma.

8.1.1.t.s: api vā pūrvam upām̐śor aparam antaryāmasya /
8.1.1.t.d: अपि वा पूर्वम् उपाम्̐शोर् अपरम् अन्तर्यामस्य ।
8.1.1.t.m: Or rather, the eastern for the Upāṃśu, the western for the Antaryāma.

8.1.1.u.s: te antareṇa vyānāya tvā \\ ity upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇam̐ sam̐sṛṣṭam upām̐śupātreṇa prayunakti /
8.1.1.u.d: ते अन्तरेण व्यानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणम्̐ सम्̐सृष्टम् उपाम्̐शुपात्रेण प्रयुनक्ति ।
8.1.1.u.m: Between the two, with: "For out-breathing, to you!", he sets out the Upāṃśusavana pressing-stone in contact with the Upāṃśu vessel.

8.1.1.v.s: pratyañci dvidevatyapātrāṇi parisrag aindravāyavasyājagāvan maitrāvaruṇasya dvisrakty āśvinasya /
8.1.1.v.d: प्रत्यञ्चि द्विदेवत्यपात्राणि परिस्रग् ऐन्द्रवायवस्याजगावन् मैत्रावरुणस्य द्विस्रक्त्य् आश्विनस्य ।
8.1.1.v.m: Facing west, the vessels for the twin deities: the flanged [cup] for Indra-Vāyu, the udder-shaped [cup] for Mitra-Varuṇa, the two-cornered [cup] for the Aśvins.

8.1.1.w.s: apare śukrāmanthinoḥ pātre dakṣiṇaṃ bailvam̐ śukrasyottaraṃ vaikaṅkataṃ manthinaḥ /
8.1.1.w.d: अपरे शुक्रामन्थिनोः पात्रे दक्षिणं बैल्वम्̐ शुक्रस्योत्तरं वैकङ्कतं मन्थिनः ।
8.1.1.w.m: To the west [of these], the two vessels of Śukra and Manthin: the southern, made of bilva wood, for Śukra; the northern, made of vikaṅkata wood, for Manthin.

8.1.1.x.s: apare āśvatthe aśvaśaphabudhne ubhayatomukhe ṛtupātre dakṣiṇam adhvaryor uttaraṃ pratiprasthātuḥ /
8.1.1.x.d: अपरे आश्वत्थे अश्वशफबुध्ने उभयतोमुखे ऋतुपात्रे दक्षिणम् अध्वर्योर् उत्तरं प्रतिप्रस्थातुः ।
8.1.1.x.m: To the west [of these], the two Ṛtu cups, made of aśvattha wood, shaped like a horse's hoof at the bottom, open at both ends: the southern for the adhvaryu, the northern for the pratiprasthātṛ.

8.1.1.y.m: On the southern hip, the Āgrayaṇa vessel.

8.1.1.z.m: On the northern, the Ukthya vessel and the Ukthya cup shaped like a horse's hoof at the bottom.

8.1.1.aa.m: Between them, facing north, the three Atigrāhya vessels.

8.1.1.ab.m: In front of the prop of the southern havirdhāna [cart], the Āditya vessel and the Āditya cup shaped like a horse's hoof at the bottom.

8.1.1.ac.m: In front of the prop of the northern havirdhāna [cart], where earth is not thrown up, the Dhruva vessel.

8.1.1.ad.m: At the northern shoulder, the four-cornered curd-cup made of udumbara wood.

8.1.1.af.s: yathāvakāśam ekādaśa camasān naiyagrodhān rauhitakān vā //
8.1.1.af.d: यथावकाशम् एकादश चमसान् नैयग्रोधान् रौहितकान् वा ॥
8.1.1.af.m: According to space, eleven camasa cups made of nyagrodha or of rohitaka wood,

8.1.2.b.m: The Vāyavya cups are a span high, elevated at the rims, and constricted in the middle.

8.1.2.c.m: As an offering ladle without a handle, so is the pariplavā.

8.1.2.d.s: teṣāṃ yāny anādiṣṭavṛkṣāṇi vikaṅkatasya tāny ahomārthāni tu vāraṇasya /
8.1.2.d.d: तेषां यान्य् अनादिष्टवृक्षाणि विकङ्कतस्य तान्य् अहोमार्थानि तु वारणस्य ।
8.1.2.d.m: Among them, those whose wood is not specified are made of vikaṅkata, but those not meant for offering are made of varaṇa.

8.1.2.e.s: yunajmi te pṛthivīṃ jyotiṣā saha \\ iti dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya paścādakṣaṃ droṇakalaśam̐ sadaśāpavitraṃ prayunakti /
8.1.2.e.d: युनज्मि ते पृथिवीं ज्योतिषा सह \\ इति दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पश्चादक्षं द्रोणकलशम्̐ सदशापवित्रं प्रयुनक्ति ।
8.1.2.e.m: With: "I yoke your earth along with light...", he sets out behind the axle of the southern havirdhāna [cart] the droṇakalaśa trough together with the fringed strainer.

8.1.2.f.s: yunajmi vāyum antarikṣeṇa te saha \\ ity uttarasya nīḍa ādhavanīyam /
8.1.2.f.d: युनज्मि वायुम् अन्तरिक्षेण ते सह \\ इत्य् उत्तरस्य नीड आधवनीयम् ।
8.1.2.f.m: With: "I yoke your wind along with intermediate space...", [he sets out] the ādhavanīya trough in the seat of the northern [cart].

8.1.2.g.s: yunajmi vācam̐ saha sūryeṇa te \\ iti tasyaiva pradhure pūtabhṛtam /
8.1.2.g.d: युनज्मि वाचम्̐ सह सूर्येण ते \\ इति तस्यैव प्रधुरे पूतभृतम् ।
8.1.2.g.m: With: "I yoke your speech along with the sun...", [he sets out] the pūtabhṛt jar at the front pole of that very same [cart].

8.1.2.h.s: paścādakṣaṃ tisra ekadhanā sthālī yunajmi tisro vipṛcaḥ sūryasya te \\ iti sruco 'bhimṛśati /
8.1.2.h.d: पश्चादक्षं तिस्र एकधना स्थाली युनज्मि तिस्रो विपृचः सूर्यस्य ते \\ इति स्रुचो ऽभिमृशति ।
8.1.2.h.m: Behind the axle, [he sets out] the three ekadhanā jars; with: "I yoke the three separations of your sun...", he touches the offering ladles.

8.1.2.i.s: atrādhiṣavaṇacarmaṇo grāvṇām iti prayojanam eke samāmananti /
8.1.2.i.d: अत्राधिषवणचर्मणो ग्राव्णाम् इति प्रयोजनम् एके समामनन्ति ।
8.1.2.i.m: At this point, some hand down the placing of the pressing skin and the pressing stones.

8.1.2.j.s: apāṃ kṣayā ṛtasya garbhā bhuvanasya gopāḥ śyenā atithayaḥ parvatānāṃ kakubhaḥ prayuto na pātāras \\ vagnunendram̐ hvayata \ ghoṣeṇāmīvām̐ś cātayata \ yuktāḥ stha \ vahata svargaṃ lokam \ abhivahata yajamānam ity upare grāvṇaḥ saṃmukhān kṛtvābhimantrayate /
8.1.2.j.d: अपां क्षया ऋतस्य गर्भा भुवनस्य गोपाः श्येना अतिथयः पर्वतानां ककुभः प्रयुतो न पातारस् \\ वग्नुनेन्द्रम्̐ ह्वयत \ घोषेणामीवाम्̐श् चातयत \ युक्ताः स्थ \ वहत स्वर्गं लोकम् \ अभिवहत यजमानम् इत्य् उपरे ग्राव्णः संमुखान् कृत्वाभिमन्त्रयते ।
8.1.2.j.m: Having turned the pressing stones face to face on the lower stone, he addresses them with: "Dwellers in the waters, embryos of cosmic order, protectors of the world, falcons, guests of the mountains, summits, protectors without neglect! Summon Indra with your sound; drive away the afflictions with your roar; you are yoked; convey [us] to the heavenly world; convey the sacrificer thither!"

8.1.2.k.s: āsanyān mā mantrāt pāhi \\ ity āgnīdhre juhoti /
8.1.2.k.d: आसन्यान् मा मन्त्रात् पाहि \\ इत्य् आग्नीध्रे जुहोति ।
8.1.2.k.m: With: "Protect me from a mantra that comes from the mouth!", he offers into the Āgnīdhra [fire].

8.1.2.l.s: hṛde tvā \ manase tvā \\ iti dvābhyām antareṣām̐ rājānaṃ grāvasūpāvaharati /
8.1.2.l.d: हृदे त्वा \ मनसे त्वा \\ इति द्वाभ्याम् अन्तरेषाम्̐ राजानं ग्रावसूपावहरति ।
8.1.2.l.m: With the two [formulas]: "For the heart, to you!", "For the mind, to you!", he brings down King [Soma] between the stones.

8.1.2.m.m: For one desiring heaven, he should offer the Pañcahotṛ formula into the Āgnīdhra [fire], according to some.

8.1.2.n.m: Before speech is uttered [by birds], he undertakes the morning recitation.

8.1.2.p.s: devebhyaḥ prātaryāvabhyo 'nubrūhi \ brahman vācaṃ yaccha \ subrahmaṇya subrahmaṇyām āhvaya \ pratiprasthātaḥ savanīyān nirvapa \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
8.1.2.p.d: देवेभ्यः प्रातर्यावभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ ब्रह्मन् वाचं यच्छ \ सुब्रह्मण्य सुब्रह्मण्याम् आह्वय \ प्रतिप्रस्थातः सवनीयान् निर्वप \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
8.1.2.p.m: He directs: "Recite for the gods who go early! Brahman, restrain speech! Subrahmaṇya, chant the Subrahmaṇyā! Pratiprasthātṛ, apportion the portions for the animal of the pressing day!"

8.1.2.q.s: pratiprasthātā savanīyānāṃ pātrasam̐sādanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate yathārtham oṣadhipātrāṇi prayunakti /
8.1.2.q.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता सवनीयानां पात्रसम्̐सादनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते यथार्थम् ओषधिपात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति ।
8.1.2.q.m: The pratiprasthātṛ undertakes the rites for the savanīya offerings, beginning with the placing of the utensils, [and] sets out the plant vessels as required.

8.1.2.r.s: dve bharjanārthe kapāle aṣṭau puroḍāśārthāny āmikṣārthām̐ sthālīm /
8.1.2.r.d: द्वे भर्जनार्थे कपाले अष्टौ पुरोडाशार्थान्य् आमिक्षार्थाम्̐ स्थालीम् ।
8.1.2.r.m: Two potsherds for parching, eight for the sacrificial cake, [and] a pot for the āmikṣā.

8.1.2.s.s: nirvapaṇakāla indrāya harivate dhānā nirvapatīndrāya pūṣaṇvate karambham̐ sarasvatyai bhāratyai parivāpalājān indrāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam /
8.1.2.s.d: निर्वपणकाल इन्द्राय हरिवते धाना निर्वपतीन्द्राय पूषण्वते करम्भम्̐ सरस्वत्यै भारत्यै परिवापलाजान् इन्द्राय पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालम् ।
8.1.2.s.m: At the time of portioning out, he portions out the parched grains for Indra with bay steeds, the porridge for Indra accompanied by Pūṣan, the roasted barley grains for Sarasvatī Bhāratī, [and] the sacrificial cake on eight potsherds for Indra.

8.1.2.t.s: prokṣiteṣu vibhāgamantreṇa vrīhīn vibhajyārdhān avahanty ardhām̐l lājārthān nidadhāti /
8.1.2.t.d: प्रोक्षितेषु विभागमन्त्रेण व्रीहीन् विभज्यार्धान् अवहन्त्य् अर्धाम्̐ल् लाजार्थान् निदधाति ।
8.1.2.t.m: When they have been sprinkled, he divides the rice grains with the division mantra, threshes half, and sets aside half for roasted barley grains.

8.1.2.u.s: prathamena kapālamantreṇa dhānārthaṃ lājārthaṃ ca kapāle upadadhāti /
8.1.2.u.d: प्रथमेन कपालमन्त्रेण धानार्थं लाजार्थं च कपाले उपदधाति ।
8.1.2.u.m: With the first potsherd mantra, he places [two] potsherds: for the parched grains and for the roasted barley grains.

8.1.2.v.s: aṣṭau puroḍāśasyopadhāyāmikṣāyāḥ kalpena maitrāvaruṇīm āmikṣāṃ karoti /
8.1.2.v.d: अष्टौ पुरोडाशस्योपधायामिक्षायाः कल्पेन मैत्रावरुणीम् आमिक्षां करोति ।
8.1.2.v.m: Having placed the eight [potsherds] for the sacrificial cake, he prepares the āmikṣā for Mitra and Varuṇa according to the procedure for āmikṣā.

8.1.2.w.m: With the heating mantra, he roasts the parched grains and the roasted barley grains.

8.1.2.x.m: They remain lying there without being burnt.

8.1.2.y.s: yat prāg alaṃkaraṇāt tat kṛtvā vibhāgamantreṇa dhānā vibhajya piṣṭānām āvṛtārdhāḥ saktūn kṛtvā saṃyavanamantreṇa saṃyauti sa karambho bhavati /
8.1.2.y.d: यत् प्राग् अलंकरणात् तत् कृत्वा विभागमन्त्रेण धाना विभज्य पिष्टानाम् आवृतार्धाः सक्तून् कृत्वा संयवनमन्त्रेण संयौति स करम्भो भवति ।
8.1.2.y.m: Having performed whatever occurs prior to the embellishment, having divided the parched grains with the division mantra, having made half into flour according to the procedure for flour, he mixes it with the mixing mantra: that becomes the porridge.

8.1.2.z.s: analaṃkṛteṣu \\ abhūd uṣā ruśatpaśus \\ āgnir adhāyy ṛtviyas \\ ity etasyām̐ śasyamānāyām \\ śṛṇotv agniḥ samidhā havaṃ me \\ ity etac caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
8.1.2.z.d: अनलंकृतेषु \\ अभूद् उषा रुशत्पशुस् \\ आग्निर् अधाय्य् ऋत्वियस् \\ इत्य् एतस्याम्̐ शस्यमानायाम् \\ शृणोत्व् अग्निः समिधा हवं मे \\ इत्य् एतच् चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति ।
8.1.2.z.m: While [the oblations] are not yet embellished, as the verse, 'Dawn has arisen, bright-herded, Agni, appropriate for the season, has been established' is being recited, he offers this fourfold-drawn portion with the mantra: 'May Agni with firewood hear my call.'

8.1.3.a.s: darbhamuṣṭiṃ dhārayamāṇas \\ apa iṣya hotar \ maitrāvaruṇasya camasādhvaryav ādrava \\ ekadhanina ādravata \ neṣṭaḥ patnīm udānaya \\ unnetar hotṛcamasena vasatīvarībhiś ca cātvālaṃ pratyupāssva \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
8.1.3.a.d: दर्भमुष्टिं धारयमाणस् \\ अप इष्य होतर् \ मैत्रावरुणस्य चमसाध्वर्यव् आद्रव \\ एकधनिन आद्रवत \ नेष्टः पत्नीम् उदानय \\ उन्नेतर् होतृचमसेन वसतीवरीभिश् च चात्वालं प्रत्युपास्स्व \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
8.1.3.a.m: holding a bunch of darbha grass, he gives the ritual direction: 'Desire the waters, O hotṛ! O cup-adhvaryu of the Maitrāvaruṇa, run forward! O holders of the ekadhana waters, run forward! O neṣṭṛ, bring up the sacrificer's wife! O unnetṛ, sit facing the cātvāla with the hotṛ's cup and the vasatīvarī waters!'

8.1.3.b.m: Taking the cup, the cup-adhvaryu of the Maitrāvaruṇa runs forward.

8.1.3.c.m: Taking the pots of ekadhana waters, at least three, an odd number [of priests] run forward.

8.1.3.d.s: prehy udehi \\ iti neṣṭā patnīm udānayati /
8.1.3.d.d: प्रेह्य् उदेहि \\ इति नेष्टा पत्नीम् उदानयति ।
8.1.3.d.m: With the words, 'Come forward, come up,' the neṣṭṛ brings up the sacrificer's wife.

8.1.3.e.s: yatra hotuḥ prātaranuvākam anubruvata upaśaṇuyāt tad apo 'dhvaryur gṛhṇīyāt /
8.1.3.e.d: यत्र होतुः प्रातरनुवाकम् अनुब्रुवत उपशणुयात् तद् अपो ऽध्वर्युर् गृह्णीयात् ।
8.1.3.e.m: Where the adhvaryu can hear the hotṛ reciting the morning litany, there he should draw the waters.

8.1.3.f.s: yadi dūre syur udūhya gṛhṇīyād yatra hotuḥ śṛṇoti /
8.1.3.f.d: यदि दूरे स्युर् उदूह्य गृह्णीयाद् यत्र होतुः शृणोति ।
8.1.3.f.m: If they are far away, he should draw them having moved them up to where he hears the hotṛ.

8.1.3.g.s: apsu tṛṇaṃ prāsya devīr āpas \\ ity etac caturgṛhītaṃ juhoti /
8.1.3.g.d: अप्सु तृणं प्रास्य देवीर् आपस् \\ इत्य् एतच् चतुर्गृहीतं जुहोति ।
8.1.3.g.m: Having thrown a grass blade into the waters, he offers this fourfold-drawn portion with: 'O divine waters…'

8.1.3.i.s: yadi vā purā tṛṇaṃ bhavati tasminn eva juhoti /
8.1.3.i.d: यदि वा पुरा तृणं भवति तस्मिन्न् एव जुहोति ।
8.1.3.i.m: Or if there is already a grass blade beforehand, he offers into that very one.

8.1.3.j.s: kārṣir asi \\ iti darbhair āhutim apaplāvayati /
8.1.3.j.d: कार्षिर् असि \\ इति दर्भैर् आहुतिम् अपप्लावयति ।
8.1.3.j.m: With the words, 'You are a furrow,' he floats away the oblation with darbha blades.

8.1.3.k.s: samudrasya vo 'kṣityā unnaye \\ ity aghṛtaliptānāṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasenonnayati /
8.1.3.k.d: समुद्रस्य वो ऽक्षित्या उन्नये \\ इत्य् अघृतलिप्तानां मैत्रावरुणचमसेनोन्नयति ।
8.1.3.k.m: With the words, 'For the ocean's inexhaustibility, I draw you up,' he draws up with the cup of the Maitrāvaruṇa [some] of [the waters] that are not smeared with clarified butter.

8.1.3.l.m: With that very mantra [they draw waters] into the ekadhana vessels.

8.1.3.m.s: vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhyas \\ iti patnī pannejanīr gṛhṇāti /
8.1.3.m.d: वसुभ्यो रुद्रेभ्य आदित्येभ्यस् \\ इति पत्नी पन्नेजनीर् गृह्णाति ।
8.1.3.m.m: With the words, 'For the Vasus, for the Rudras, for the Ādityas,' the sacrificer's wife takes the water for washing feet.

8.1.3.n.m: Those who brought the pots bring [them] forward.

8.1.3.o.m: With that very mantra, the neṣṭṛ brings up the sacrificer's wife.

8.1.3.p.s: pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśyāgreṇa praśāstrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ parītyāpareṇa neṣṭur dhiṣṇiyaṃ vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhyas \\ iti patnī pannejanīḥ sādayati /
8.1.3.p.d: पूर्वेण द्वारेण सदः प्रविश्याग्रेण प्रशास्त्रीयं धिष्णियं परीत्यापरेण नेष्टुर् धिष्णियं वसुभ्यो रुद्रेभ्य आदित्येभ्यस् \\ इति पत्नी पन्नेजनीः सादयति ।
8.1.3.p.m: Entering the sadas by the eastern door, going around the praśāstṛ's dhiṣṇiya hearth from the front, behind the neṣṭṛ's dhiṣṇiya hearth, the sacrificer's wife sets down the water for washing feet with the words, 'For the Vasus, for the Rudras, for the Ādityas.'

8.1.3.q.s: vasavo rudā ādityā etā vaḥ pannejanīs \ tā rakṣadhvam iti vā /
8.1.3.q.d: वसवो रुदा आदित्या एता वः पन्नेजनीस् \ ता रक्षध्वम् इति वा ।
8.1.3.q.m: Or [she does so] with: 'O Vasus, Rudras, Ādityas, this is your water for washing feet; protect it.'

8.1.4.a.s: saṃ vo dadhātu varuṇaḥ \ sam indraḥ saṃ dhātā saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ / \ tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā sam̐rarāṇas \\ yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātu \ yathādhuraṃ dhuro dhūrbhiḥ kalpantām ity upari cātvāle hotṛcamasaṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasaṃ ca sam̐sparśya vasatīvarīr vyānayati /
8.1.4.a.d: सं वो दधातु वरुणः \ सम् इन्द्रः सं धाता सं बृहस्पतिः । \ त्वष्टा विष्णुः प्रजया सम्̐रराणस् \\ यजमानाय द्रविणं दधातु \ यथाधुरं धुरो धूर्भिः कल्पन्ताम् इत्य् उपरि चात्वाले होतृचमसं मैत्रावरुणचमसं च सम्̐स्पर्श्य वसतीवरीर् व्यानयति ।
8.1.4.a.m: Above the cātvāla, touching the hotṛ's cup and the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup together, he pours out the vasatīvarī waters mutually with the mantra: 'May Varuṇa unite you, may Indra, may Dhātṛ, may Bṛhaspati unite you; may Tvaṣṭṛ, Viṣṇu, rejoicing together in offspring, grant wealth to the sacrificer; let the yokes be fitted according to the yoke with the yoke-pins.'

8.1.4.b.s: hotṛcamase vasatīvarīṇāṃ niṣicya maitrāvaruṇacamasa ānayati maitrāvaruṇacamasād dhotṛcamase /
8.1.4.b.d: होतृचमसे वसतीवरीणां निषिच्य मैत्रावरुणचमस आनयति मैत्रावरुणचमसाद् धोतृचमसे ।
8.1.4.b.m: Having poured [some] of the vasatīvarī waters into the hotṛ's cup, he pours [some] into the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup; from the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup into the hotṛ's cup.

8.1.4.c.s: hotṛcamasaṃ maitrāvaruṇacamasaṃ ca pracaraṇyā samanakti saṃ vo 'naktu varuṇas \\ iti mantrādiṃ saṃnamati /
8.1.4.c.d: होतृचमसं मैत्रावरुणचमसं च प्रचरण्या समनक्ति सं वो ऽनक्तु वरुणस् \\ इति मन्त्रादिं संनमति ।
8.1.4.c.m: He anoints the hotṛ's cup and the Maitrāvaruṇa's cup with the pracaraṇī ladle; he adapts the beginning of the mantra to: 'May Varuṇa anoint you…'

8.1.4.e.s: adhvaryo 'ver apā3s \\ iti hotādhvaryuṃ triḥ pṛcchati /
8.1.4.e.d: अध्वर्यो ऽवेर् अपा3स् \\ इति होताध्वर्युं त्रिः पृच्छति ।
8.1.4.e.m: The hotṛ asks the adhvaryu three times: 'O adhvaryu, did you obtain the waters?'

8.1.4.f.s: utem anannamur uta \\ iti triḥ pratyāha /
8.1.4.f.d: उतेम् अनन्नमुर् उत \\ इति त्रिः प्रत्याह ।
8.1.4.f.m: He replies three times: 'Yea, they have submitted, yea.'

8.1.4.g.s: yam agne pṛtsu martyam iti pracaraṇyā kratukaraṇaṃ juhoti yadi śeṣo bhavati /
8.1.4.g.d: यम् अग्ने पृत्सु मर्त्यम् इति प्रचरण्या क्रतुकरणं जुहोति यदि शेषो भवति ।
8.1.4.g.m: With the pracaraṇī ladle, he offers the kratukaraṇa oblation with: 'Which mortal, O Agni, in battles…', if there is a residue.

8.1.4.h.s: avidyamāne 'nyac caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā tat sarvaṃ juhoti /
8.1.4.h.d: अविद्यमाने ऽन्यच् चतुर्गृहीतं गृहीत्वा तत् सर्वं जुहोति ।
8.1.4.h.m: If none is available, having taken another fourfold-drawn portion, he offers the whole of it.

8.1.4.i.m: He places the pracaraṇī ladle on the front of the pole of the southern havirdhāna cart.

8.1.4.j.s: yaṃ kāmayeta klībaḥ syād ity adhastāt tasya /
8.1.4.j.d: यं कामयेत क्लीबः स्याद् इत्य् अधस्तात् तस्य ।
8.1.4.j.m: [In the case of a sacrificer] whom he wishes to be impotent, [he places it] beneath it.

8.1.4.k.m: He causes the waters to enter the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door.

8.1.4.l.s: tāsu dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyottarasyāṃ vartanyāṃ purokṣam̐ hotṛcamasam āspṛṣṭam̐ sādayati /
8.1.4.l.d: तासु दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्योत्तरस्यां वर्तन्यां पुरोक्षम्̐ होतृचमसम् आस्पृष्टम्̐ सादयति ।
8.1.4.l.m: Among them, he sets down the hotṛ's cup on the northern wheel-track of the southern havirdhāna cart, in front of the axle, touching [it].

8.1.4.m.m: [He places] the others in the northern havirdhāna cart as there is room.

8.1.4.n.s: nigrābhyāḥ stha devaśrutaḥ śukrāḥ śukrabhṛtaḥ pūtāḥ pūtabhṛtas \\ āyurme tarpayata \\ iti hotṛcamase yajamānaṃ vācayati tā nigrābhyā bhavanti //
8.1.4.n.d: निग्राभ्याः स्थ देवश्रुतः शुक्राः शुक्रभृतः पूताः पूतभृतस् \\ आयुर्मे तर्पयत \\ इति होतृचमसे यजमानं वाचयति ता निग्राभ्या भवन्ति ॥
8.1.4.n.m: He makes the sacrificer recite over the hotṛ's cup: 'You are the nigrābhyā waters, heard by the gods, bright, bearers of brightness, purified, bearers of the purified; satisfy my life-breath'; they become the nigrābhyā waters.

8.2.5.a.m: He proceeds with the dadhigraha cup.

8.2.5.b.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ prajāpataye tvā jyotiṣmate jyotiṣmantaṃ gṛhṇāmi \\ iti dadhigrahapātre dadhigrahaṃ gṛhṇāti \\ apendra dviṣato manas \\ iti harati prāṇāya tvā \\ apānāya tvā \\ iti juhoti /
8.2.5.b.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ प्रजापतये त्वा ज्योतिष्मते ज्योतिष्मन्तं गृह्णामि \\ इति दधिग्रहपात्रे दधिग्रहं गृह्णाति \\ अपेन्द्र द्विषतो मनस् \\ इति हरति प्राणाय त्वा \\ अपानाय त्वा \\ इति जुहोति ।
8.2.5.b.m: He draws the dadhigraha into the dadhigraha vessel with the words: 'You are taken with a support; I take you, the radiant one, for the radiant Prajāpati'; he carries it forward with: 'O Indra, [turn away] the mind of the enemy'; he offers it with: 'To the in-breath, hail! To the out-breath, hail!'

8.2.5.c.s: ājyagrahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt tejaskāmasya somagrahaṃ gṛhṇīyād brahmavarcasakāmasyeti /
8.2.5.c.d: आज्यग्रहं गृह्णीयात् तेजस्कामस्य सोमग्रहं गृह्णीयाद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्येति ।
8.2.5.c.m: He should draw a cup of clarified butter for one who desires fiery energy; he should draw a soma cup for one who desires brahminical splendour.

8.2.5.d.m: The procedure for both of them is explained by the dadhigraha.

8.2.5.e.m: 'He should draw a dadhigraha for one who desires cattle': [this applies] to the obligatory and optional [performances].

8.2.5.f.s: somagrahaṃ grahīṣyan rājānam apādatte yāvantam ekagrahāyāptaṃ manyate /
8.2.5.f.d: सोमग्रहं ग्रहीष्यन् राजानम् अपादत्ते यावन्तम् एकग्रहायाप्तं मन्यते ।
8.2.5.f.m: When he is about to draw the soma cup, he takes off as much of the King [Soma] as he considers sufficient for a single cup.

8.2.5.g.m: Having tied up the rest again, he sets it down.

8.2.5.h.s: tam upare nupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya \\ avīvṛdhaṃ vas \\ ity abhimantrya /
8.2.5.h.d: तम् उपरे नुप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य \\ अवीवृधं वस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य ।
8.2.5.h.m: Having scattered it on the lower pressing-stone, poured the vasatīvarī waters over it, and consecrated it with: 'I have made you grow…',

8.2.5.i.s: tisro yahvasya samidhaḥ parijman \ devā akṛṇvann uśijo amartyave / \ tāsām ekām adadhur martye bhujam \\ lokam u dve upa jāmīnaṃ īyatur iti grāvṇā yathārtham abhiṣuṇoti /
8.2.5.i.d: तिस्रो यह्वस्य समिधः परिज्मन् \ देवा अकृण्वन्न् उशिजो अमर्त्यवे । \ तासाम् एकाम् अदधुर् मर्त्ये भुजम् \\ लोकम् उ द्वे उप जामीनं ईयतुर् इति ग्राव्णा यथार्थम् अभिषुणोति ।
8.2.5.i.m: he presses it with the pressing-stone as required, with the verse: 'Three are the fuel-sticks of the mighty [Agni] roaming about, which the gods, eager [for him], created for immortality; one of them they placed among mortals for enjoyment, and two have gone to the companion world.'

8.2.5.j.s: ā māskān iti yo 'bhiṣūyamāṇasya prathamo 'm̐śuḥ skandati tam abhimantrayate pratyāharati vā /
8.2.5.j.d: आ मास्कान् इति यो ऽभिषूयमाणस्य प्रथमो ऽम्̐शुः स्कन्दति तम् अभिमन्त्रयते प्रत्याहरति वा ।
8.2.5.j.m: With the words, 'Do not leap away from me,' he recites over the first shoot that drops while it is being pressed, or he puts it back.

8.2.5.k.m: With the words, 'A drop has leapt down,' he recites over drops [that fall].

8.2.5.l.m: This is the procedure for all pressings.

8.2.5.m.m: This pressing mantra applies only to this [rite].

8.2.5.n.s: tam̐ sahiraṇyena pāṇinā gṛhītvā sahiraṇyena prāṅmukhas tiṣṭhan dakṣiṇārdhapūrvārdhe juhoty uttarārdhapūrvārdhe vā /
8.2.5.n.d: तम्̐ सहिरण्येन पाणिना गृहीत्वा सहिरण्येन प्राङ्मुखस् तिष्ठन् दक्षिणार्धपूर्वार्धे जुहोत्य् उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे वा ।
8.2.5.n.m: Having taken it with a hand holding gold, standing facing east with gold [in hand], he offers it in the eastern half of the southern half, or in the eastern half of the northern half.

8.2.5.o.m: Wherever this [rule applies], there [he offers] all soma oblations.

8.2.5.q.s: pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśyāgreṇa hotāraṃ purastātpratyaṅṅ āsīnas \\ nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā \\ ity avekṣya mandrābhibhūtis \\ iti bhakṣayati /
8.2.5.q.d: पूर्वेण द्वारेण सदः प्रविश्याग्रेण होतारं पुरस्तात्प्रत्यङ्ङ् आसीनस् \\ नृचक्षसं त्वा \\ इत्य् अवेक्ष्य मन्द्राभिभूतिस् \\ इति भक्षयति ।
8.2.5.q.m: Entering the sadas by the eastern door, sitting in front of the hotṛ facing west, having looked at it with the words, 'You who look on men…', he consumes it with: 'Of delightful power…'

8.2.5.r.s: svayam āharan bhakṣam avekṣaṇaprabhṛtinā bhakṣamantreṇa pratipadyate /
8.2.5.r.d: स्वयम् आहरन् भक्षम् अवेक्षणप्रभृतिना भक्षमन्त्रेण प्रतिपद्यते ।
8.2.5.r.m: Bringing [the portion] himself, he partakes [of it] with the consumption mantra beginning with looking at it.

8.2.5.s.s: bhakṣehi \\ ity anyenāhriyamāṇaṃ pratīkṣate \\ aśvinos tvā bāhubhyām̐ saghyāsam iti pratigṛhya nṛcakṣasaṃ tvā \\ ity avekṣya mandrābhibhūtis \\ ity anudrutya vasumadgaṇasya soma deva te \\ iti //
8.2.5.s.d: भक्षेहि \\ इत्य् अन्येनाह्रियमाणं प्रतीक्षते \\ अश्विनोस् त्वा बाहुभ्याम्̐ सघ्यासम् इति प्रतिगृह्य नृचक्षसं त्वा \\ इत्य् अवेक्ष्य मन्द्राभिभूतिस् \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य वसुमद्गणस्य सोम देव ते \\ इति ॥
8.2.5.s.m: When it is being brought by another, he waits for it with, "Come, O potion!" Having received it with, "May I grasp you with the arms of the Aśvins," looking at it with, "You who observe men," and reciting, "Exhilarating, overcoming," [he consumes it with,] "Of the troop accompanied by the Vasus, O god Soma, your [portion]..."

8.2.6.a.s: prātaḥsavane sarvasomān bhakṣayanti narāśam̐sapītasya \\ iti nārāśam̐sān /
8.2.6.a.d: प्रातःसवने सर्वसोमान् भक्षयन्ति नराशम्̐सपीतस्य \\ इति नाराशम्̐सान् ।
8.2.6.a.m: At the morning pressing, they consume all the Soma portions [with this formula], and the Nārāśaṃsa portions with, "...drunk by Narāśaṃsa."

8.2.6.b.s: rudravadgaṇasya soma deva te \\ iti mādhyaṃdine savane sarvasomān bhakṣayanti narāśam̐sapītasya \\ iti nārāśam̐sān ādityavadgaṇasya soma deva te \\ iti tṛtīyasavane sarvasomān bhakṣayanti narāśam̐sapītasya \\ iti nārāśam̐sān /
8.2.6.b.d: रुद्रवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते \\ इति माध्यंदिने सवने सर्वसोमान् भक्षयन्ति नराशम्̐सपीतस्य \\ इति नाराशम्̐सान् आदित्यवद्गणस्य सोम देव ते \\ इति तृतीयसवने सर्वसोमान् भक्षयन्ति नराशम्̐सपीतस्य \\ इति नाराशम्̐सान् ।
8.2.6.b.m: At the midday pressing, they consume all the Soma portions with, "Of the troop accompanied by the Rudras, O god Soma, your [portion]...", and the Nārāśaṃsa portions with, "...drunk by Narāśaṃsa." At the third pressing, they consume all the Soma portions with, "Of the troop accompanied by the Ādityas, O god Soma, your [portion]...", and the Nārāśaṃsa portions with, "...drunk by Narāśaṃsa."

8.2.6.c.m: Whatever [in the mantra] comes before "accompanied by the Vasus", he attaches everywhere.

8.2.6.d.s: vāg devī somasya pibatu \\ iti sārvatrikam eke samāmananti /
8.2.6.d.d: वाग् देवी सोमस्य पिबतु \\ इति सार्वत्रिकम् एके समामनन्ति ।
8.2.6.d.m: Some teach as applicable everywhere: "May the divine speech drink of Soma."

8.2.6.e.s: hinva me gātrā harivas \\ iti somaṃ bhakṣayitvātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśante /
8.2.6.e.d: हिन्व मे गात्रा हरिवस् \\ इति सोमं भक्षयित्वात्मानं प्रत्यभिमृशन्ते ।
8.2.6.e.m: Having consumed the Soma, they touch themselves with, "Gladden my limbs, O possessor of bay steeds."

8.2.6.f.m: Having washed the vessel at the mārjālīya [hearth], he sets it down in its proper place.

8.2.6.g.m: This is the rule for all Soma [portions].

8.2.6.h.m: In the case of the cups (grahas), however, there is the accompaniment of gold.

8.2.6.i.m: And consumption is only after both offering and pressing, not after either rite alone.

8.2.6.j.m: The vessel for the Dadhigraha, the Aṃśu, and the Adābhya is the same.

8.2.6.l.s: rājānam apādatte yāvantam ekagrahāyāptaṃ manyate pratyupanahyetaraṃ nidadhāti tam upare nyupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya sakṛdabhiṣutasya prāṇyāpānya prāṇān vāmadevyaṃ manasā gāyamāno gṛhṇāti /
8.2.6.l.d: राजानम् अपादत्ते यावन्तम् एकग्रहायाप्तं मन्यते प्रत्युपनह्येतरं निदधाति तम् उपरे न्युप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य सकृदभिषुतस्य प्राण्यापान्य प्राणान् वामदेव्यं मनसा गायमानो गृह्णाति ।
8.2.6.l.m: He takes of King [Soma] as much as he considers sufficient for one cup, ties up the rest and sets it down; pouring it out onto the lower pressing stone and sprinkling it with the Vasatīvarī waters, while it is once pressed, inhaling and exhaling through the breaths, singing the Vāmadevya [sāman] mentally, he draws [the cup].

8.2.6.m.s: kayā naś citra ābhuvat \\ iti vā vāmadevyasyarcā /
8.2.6.m.d: कया नश् चित्र आभुवत् \\ इति वा वामदेव्यस्यर्चा ।
8.2.6.m.m: Or the verse for the Vāmadevya is: "By what wonderful [aid] has he become present to us...?"

8.2.6.n.s: yady anavānaṃ na śaknuyād gṛhītum ā naḥ prāṇa etu parāvatas \\ iti hiraṇyam̐ śatamānam abhivyanya vare datte gṛhṇāti /
8.2.6.n.d: यद्य् अनवानं न शक्नुयाद् गृहीतुम् आ नः प्राण एतु परावतस् \\ इति हिरण्यम्̐ शतमानम् अभिव्यन्य वरे दत्ते गृह्णाति ।
8.2.6.n.m: If he should not be able to draw [it] without breathing, having breathed out upon a piece of gold weighing one hundred mānas with, "May our breath return from afar," after a boon has been given, he draws [it].

8.2.6.o.m: Having touched it with the gold weighing one hundred mānas, he covers it with the gold.

8.2.6.p.s: indrāgnī me varcaḥ kṛṇutām iti harati /
8.2.6.p.d: इन्द्राग्नी मे वर्चः कृणुताम् इति हरति ।
8.2.6.p.m: He carries it forward with, "May Indra and Agni make splendor for me."

8.2.6.q.s: dadhanve vā yad īm anu \\ ity anavānaṃ juhoti /
8.2.6.q.d: दधन्वे वा यद् ईम् अनु \\ इत्य् अनवानं जुहोति ।
8.2.6.q.m: Without breathing, he offers it with, "Or when it runs along..."

8.2.6.r.m: The pratiprasthātṛ sprinkles the adhvaryu with water.

8.2.6.t.s: vasavas tvā prabṛhantu \\ ity etair upanaddhasya rājñas trīn am̐śūn asam̐spṛṣṭān pravṛhyānyasmin pātre dadhno nigrābhyāṇāṃ vā niḥṣicya māndāsu te śukra śukram ādhūnomi \\ iti tasminn etair etān am̐śūm̐s triḥ pradakṣiṇam anupariplāvayati /
8.2.6.t.d: वसवस् त्वा प्रबृहन्तु \\ इत्य् एतैर् उपनद्धस्य राज्ञस् त्रीन् अम्̐शून् असम्̐स्पृष्टान् प्रवृह्यान्यस्मिन् पात्रे दध्नो निग्राभ्याणां वा निःषिच्य मान्दासु ते शुक्र शुक्रम् आधूनोमि \\ इति तस्मिन्न् एतैर् एतान् अम्̐शूम्̐स् त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिप्लावयति ।
8.2.6.t.m: Having pulled out from the King [Soma] that is tied up three untouched stalks with these words: "May the Vasus pull you out...", and having poured into another vessel some curd or nigrābhya waters, he floats these stalks around clockwise three times in it with these words: "In the exhilarators, O bright one, I shake up your brightness."

8.2.6.u.m: Four times, five times, or seven times—the remaining options are for the sake of choice.

8.2.6.v.s: śukraṃ te śukreṇa gṛhṇāmi \\ agniḥ prātaḥsavane \ viśve devās \\ idaṃ tṛtīyam̐ savanaṃ kavīnām ity enābhirgṛhṇāti sarvāsāmantata upayāmā bhavanti /
8.2.6.v.d: शुक्रं ते शुक्रेण गृह्णामि \\ अग्निः प्रातःसवने \ विश्वे देवास् \\ इदं तृतीयम्̐ सवनं कवीनाम् इत्य् एनाभिर्गृह्णाति सर्वासामन्तत उपयामा भवन्ति ।
8.2.6.v.m: He draws [the cup] with these [formulas]: "I take your bright [juice] with the bright...", "Agni at the morning pressing...", "All the gods...", "This is the third pressing of the wise..."; at the end of all of them are the upayāmas.

8.2.6.w.m: He carries it forward with, "Fierce [warriors] have set it moving in this [sacrifice]."

8.2.6.x.s: kakuham̐ rūpaṃ vṛṣabhasya rocate bṛhat \\ ity abhimantrayate /
8.2.6.x.d: ककुहम्̐ रूपं वृषभस्य रोचते बृहत् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
8.2.6.x.m: He consecrates it with the mantra, "The prominent form of the bull shines loftily."

8.2.6.y.s: somaḥ somasya purogās \\ iti juhoti prajñātān am̐śūn nidadhāti //
8.2.6.y.d: सोमः सोमस्य पुरोगास् \\ इति जुहोति प्रज्ञातान् अम्̐शून् निदधाति ॥
8.2.6.y.m: He offers it with, "Soma, the forerunner of Soma...", and puts aside the marked stalks.

8.3.7.a.s: devasya tvā \\ ity upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇam ādāya vācaṃ yacchaty āgrayaṇasya grahaṇāt /
8.3.7.a.d: देवस्य त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणम् आदाय वाचं यच्छत्य् आग्रयणस्य ग्रहणात् ।
8.3.7.a.m: Taking the Upāṃśusavana pressing stone with, "At the impulse of the god...", he restrains his speech until the drawing of the Āgrayaṇa cup.

8.3.7.b.m: He consecrates it with the mantra, "A pressing stone are you..."

8.3.7.c.s: tam adhiṣavaṇa ūrdhvasānuṃ nidhāya \\ indrāya tvā vṛtraghne \\ ity etair mantrai rājānam abhimimīte yathā kraye 'nyad upasamūhanāt /
8.3.7.c.d: तम् अधिषवण ऊर्ध्वसानुं निधाय \\ इन्द्राय त्वा वृत्रघ्ने \\ इत्य् एतैर् मन्त्रै राजानम् अभिमिमीते यथा क्रये ऽन्यद् उपसमूहनात् ।
8.3.7.c.m: Placing it on the pressing skin with its ridge upward, he measures out King [Soma] with these mantras: "For Indra, slayer of Vṛtra...", as in the case of the purchase, except for the pushing together [of the stalks].

8.3.7.d.s: adhiṣavaṇasyaikadeśe rājānam apodūhyādatte yāvantam ekagrahāyāptaṃ manyate pratyupanahyetaraṃ nidadhāti tam upare nyupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya śvātrāḥ stha vṛtraturas \\ iti nigrābhyābhir upasṛjati /
8.3.7.d.d: अधिषवणस्यैकदेशे राजानम् अपोदूह्यादत्ते यावन्तम् एकग्रहायाप्तं मन्यते प्रत्युपनह्येतरं निदधाति तम् उपरे न्युप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य श्वात्राः स्थ वृत्रतुरस् \\ इति निग्राभ्याभिर् उपसृजति ।
8.3.7.d.m: Having drawn aside King [Soma] into one part of the pressing skin, he takes as much as he considers sufficient for one cup, ties up the rest and sets it down; pouring it out onto the lower pressing stone and sprinkling it with the Vasatīvarī waters, he sprinkles it with the nigrābhya waters with, "You are strengthening, overcoming Vṛtra."

8.3.7.e.s: yat te soma divi jyotis \\ ity abhimantrayate /
8.3.7.e.d: यत् ते सोम दिवि ज्योतिस् \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
8.3.7.e.m: He consecrates it with the mantra, "What light is yours, O Soma, in heaven..."

8.3.7.f.m: Some teach that the consecration with the mantra is earlier.

8.3.7.g.s: upasṛṣṭasya rājñaḥ ṣaḍ am̐śūn asam̐spṛṣṭān prabṛhya prajñātān nidhāyetarān ādāyopariṣṭād grāvāṇaṃ dhārayann adhastād am̐śūn prāg apāg udag adharāk \\ iti hotṛcamase triḥ pradakṣiṇam anupariplāvayati sa nigrābho bhavati /
8.3.7.g.d: उपसृष्टस्य राज्ञः षड् अम्̐शून् असम्̐स्पृष्टान् प्रबृह्य प्रज्ञातान् निधायेतरान् आदायोपरिष्टाद् ग्रावाणं धारयन्न् अधस्ताद् अम्̐शून् प्राग् अपाग् उदग् अधराक् \\ इति होतृचमसे त्रिः प्रदक्षिणम् अनुपरिप्लावयति स निग्राभो भवति ।
8.3.7.g.m: Having pulled out from the sprinkled King [Soma] six untouched stalks and laid them aside marked, he takes the others, holds the pressing stone above and the stalks below, and floats them clockwise three times in the Hotṛ's cup with, "Forward, backward, upward, downward"; that is the nigrābha.

8.3.7.h.s: tān upare nyupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya mā bher \ mā saṃvikthās \\ iti grāvāṇam udyamya dhiṣaṇe vīḍū satī ity adhiṣavaṇaphalake abhimantrayate /
8.3.7.h.d: तान् उपरे न्युप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य मा भेर् \ मा संविक्थास् \\ इति ग्रावाणम् उद्यम्य धिषणे वीडू सती इत्य् अधिषवणफलके अभिमन्त्रयते ।
8.3.7.h.m: Having poured them onto the lower pressing stone and sprinkled them with the Vasatīvarī waters, lifting up the pressing stone with, "Do not fear, do not tremble," he addresses the two pressing boards with, "O two pressing boards, being firm..."

8.3.7.i.s: anāgasas tvā vayam \ indreṇa preṣitā upa \ vāyuṣ ṭe astv am̐śabhūs \\ mitras te astv am̐śabhūs \\ varuṇas te astv am̐śabhūs \\ ahataḥ somo rājā \\ iti yatra mūlaṃ tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā paśyati tasmin deśe same praharati /
8.3.7.i.d: अनागसस् त्वा वयम् \ इन्द्रेण प्रेषिता उप \ वायुष् टे अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ मित्रस् ते अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ वरुणस् ते अस्त्व् अम्̐शभूस् \\ अहतः सोमो राजा \\ इति यत्र मूलं तृणं काष्ठं वा पश्यति तस्मिन् देशे समे प्रहरति ।
8.3.7.i.m: With, "We [approach] you guiltless, sent forward by Indra; may Vāyu be a stalk-sharer for you; may Mitra be a stalk-sharer for you; may Varuṇa be a stalk-sharer for you; unslain is King Soma," he strikes upon an even place where he sees a root, a blade of grass, or a piece of wood.

8.3.7.j.m: According to some, he presses having placed a blade of grass between.

8.3.7.k.d: अष्टौकृत्वो ऽग्रे ऽभिषुत्य निग्राभम् उपैति यथा पुरस्तात् ।
8.3.7.k.m: Having pressed eight times at the beginning, he proceeds to the nigrābha as before.

8.3.7.l.s: apāttānām am̐śūnāṃ dvābhyām upāśm̐upātram apidhāyottarataḥ pratiprasthātopayacchati /
8.3.7.l.d: अपात्तानाम् अम्̐शूनां द्वाभ्याम् उपाश्म्̐उपात्रम् अपिधायोत्तरतः प्रतिप्रस्थातोपयच्छति ।
8.3.7.l.m: The pratiprasthātṛ supports [the Upāṃśu vessel] from the north, having covered the Upāṃśu vessel with two of the stalks that were taken.

8.3.7.m.s: vācaspataye pavasva vājin \\ iti tasminn añjalinādhvaryuḥ somam āsiñcati /
8.3.7.m.d: वाचस्पतये पवस्व वाजिन् \\ इति तस्मिन्न् अञ्जलिनाध्वर्युः सोमम् आसिञ्चति ।
8.3.7.m.m: The adhvaryu pours the Soma into it with his joined palms with, "Flow for the lord of speech, O vigorous one!"

8.3.7.n.m: In this manner the second and third pressings are performed.

8.3.7.o.s: api vaikādaśakṛtvo dvitīyam abhiṣuṇoti dvādaśakṛtvas tṛtīyam /
8.3.7.o.d: अपि वैकादशकृत्वो द्वितीयम् अभिषुणोति द्वादशकृत्वस् तृतीयम् ।
8.3.7.o.m: Or rather, he presses eleven times the second [time], and twelve times the third [time].

8.3.7.p.s: apoddhṛtya pūrvāv am̐śū anyābhyāṃ dvitīye pātram apidhāyopayacchaty anyābhyāṃ tṛtīye devo devānām iti dvitīye somam āsiñcati madhumatīr na iṣas kṛdhi \\ iti tṛtīye /
8.3.7.p.d: अपोद्धृत्य पूर्वाव् अम्̐शू अन्याभ्यां द्वितीये पात्रम् अपिधायोपयच्छत्य् अन्याभ्यां तृतीये देवो देवानाम् इति द्वितीये सोमम् आसिञ्चति मधुमतीर् न इषस् कृधि \\ इति तृतीये ।
8.3.7.p.m: Taking away the previous two stalks, he covers the vessel with two other [stalks] and supports it during the second [pressing], and with two other [stalks] during the third; he pours the Soma into it with, "A god of the gods..." at the second, and with, "Make our nourishments full of sweetness," at the third.

8.3.7.r.m: He stands up with, "You are made self-consecrated."

8.3.7.s.m: He moves forward with, "[Through] the wide atmosphere..."

8.3.7.t.m: Stepping beyond to the north of the hotṛ,

8.3.8.a.s: manas tvāṣṭu \\ ity uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavatiṣṭhate /
8.3.8.a.d: मनस् त्वाष्टु \\ इत्य् उत्तरं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववतिष्ठते ।
8.3.8.a.m: he positions himself along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks with, "May the mind take delight in you."

8.3.8.b.s: uttaraṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavahṛtya svāhā tvā subhavaḥ sūryāya \\ iti dakṣiṇāprāñcam ṛjuṃ dīrgham̐ saṃtataṃ juhoti /
8.3.8.b.d: उत्तरं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववहृत्य स्वाहा त्वा सुभवः सूर्याय \\ इति दक्षिणाप्राञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्घम्̐ संततं जुहोति ।
8.3.8.b.m: Lowering [the cup] along the northern junction of the enclosing sticks, he makes a continuous, long, straight offering towards the southeast with, "Svāhā to you, well-born, for Sūrya!"

8.3.8.c.s: devebhyas tvā marīcipebhyas \\ iti madhyame paridhāv abhyantaraṃ lepaṃ nimārṣṭi /
8.3.8.c.d: देवेभ्यस् त्वा मरीचिपेभ्यस् \\ इति मध्यमे परिधाव् अभ्यन्तरं लेपं निमार्ष्टि ।
8.3.8.c.m: He wipes the residue on the inner side of the middle enclosing stick with, "To the gods who drink the rays..."

8.3.8.d.s: yadi kāmayeta varṣukaḥ parjanyaḥ syād iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātam /
8.3.8.d.d: यदि कामयेत वर्षुकः पर्जन्यः स्याद् इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातम् ।
8.3.8.d.m: If he should desire: 'May Parjanya bring rain,' that has been explained in the Brāhmaṇa.

8.3.8.e.m: He pours the remnant into the Āgrayaṇa trough.

8.3.8.f.s: eṣa te yoniḥ \ prāṇāya tvā \\ iti pātram̐ sādayati /
8.3.8.f.d: एष ते योनिः \ प्राणाय त्वा \\ इति पात्रम्̐ सादयति ।
8.3.8.f.m: He sets down the vessel with, "This is your womb; for the in-breath [I take] you."

8.3.8.g.s: tasminn am̐śum avadadhāti sa pariśeta ā tṛtīyasavanāt /
8.3.8.g.d: तस्मिन्न् अम्̐शुम् अवदधाति स परिशेत आ तृतीयसवनात् ।
8.3.8.g.m: He puts a stalk into it; that remains lying there until the third pressing.

8.3.8.h.s: abhicaratas tu grahaṃ gṛhītvā amuṣya tvā prāṇe sādayāmi \\ iti sādayet tam̐ sāvitreṇādāya \\ amuṃ jahy atha tvā hoṣyāmi \\ ity abhimantrya praharṣiṇo madirasya made mṛṣāsāv astu \\ iti juhoti /
8.3.8.h.d: अभिचरतस् तु ग्रहं गृहीत्वा अमुष्य त्वा प्राणे सादयामि \\ इति सादयेत् तम्̐ सावित्रेणादाय \\ अमुं जह्य् अथ त्वा होष्यामि \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्र्य प्रहर्षिणो मदिरस्य मदे मृषासाव् अस्तु \\ इति जुहोति ।
8.3.8.h.m: In the case of one practicing malevolent rites, however, having drawn the cup, he should deposit it with: 'I deposit you in the out-breath of so-and-so'; having taken it with the Savitṛ mantra, having consecrated it with: 'Kill so-and-so, then I will make offering with you', he offers it with: 'In the intoxication of the exhilarating, rapturous [draught], let so-and-so come to ruin!'

8.3.8.j.s: yadi dūre syād ā tamitos tiṣṭhet /
8.3.8.j.d: यदि दूरे स्याद् आ तमितोस् तिष्ठेत् ।
8.3.8.j.m: If [the enemy] is far away, he should stand until he is out of breath.

8.3.8.k.m: He names the person he hates.

8.3.8.l.s: devām̐śo yasmai tveḍe tat satyam apariplutā bhaṅgyena \ hato 'sau phaṭ \\ iti yo 'syām̐śur āśliṣṭa urasi vastre bāhau vā taṃ juhoti /
8.3.8.l.d: देवाम्̐शो यस्मै त्वेडे तत् सत्यम् अपरिप्लुता भङ्ग्येन \ हतो ऽसौ फट् \\ इति यो ऽस्याम्̐शुर् आश्लिष्ट उरसि वस्त्रे बाहौ वा तं जुहोति ।
8.3.8.l.m: With: 'Divine shoot, the truth for which I praise you is undisturbed by breaking; slain is so-and-so, phaṭ!', he offers whichever shoot of his has adhered to his chest, garment, or arm.

8.3.8.m.s: mahābhiṣavāya paryupaviśante purastād adhvaryur dakṣiṇataḥ pratiprasthātā paścān neṣṭottarata unnetā /
8.3.8.m.d: महाभिषवाय पर्युपविशन्ते पुरस्ताद् अध्वर्युर् दक्षिणतः प्रतिप्रस्थाता पश्चान् नेष्टोत्तरत उन्नेता ।
8.3.8.m.m: For the great pressing they sit around: the adhvaryu on the east, the pratiprasthātā on the south, the neṣṭṛ on the west, [and] the unnetṛ on the north.

8.3.8.n.s: rājānam apādatte yāvantaṃ prātaḥsavanāyāptaṃ manyate pratyupanahyetaraṃ nidadhāti tam upare nyupya \\ uśik tvaṃ deva soma \\ iti ye 'dābhyā am̐śavas teṣām ekaikam anusavanam apisṛjati yat te somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi \\ iti copām̐śupāvanānāṃ dvaudvau /
8.3.8.n.d: राजानम् अपादत्ते यावन्तं प्रातःसवनायाप्तं मन्यते प्रत्युपनह्येतरं निदधाति तम् उपरे न्युप्य \\ उशिक् त्वं देव सोम \\ इति ये ऽदाभ्या अम्̐शवस् तेषाम् एकैकम् अनुसवनम् अपिसृजति यत् ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवि \\ इति चोपाम्̐शुपावनानां द्वौद्वौ ।
8.3.8.n.m: He takes up King [Soma] as much as he thinks sufficient for the morning pressing; having tied up the other portion, he puts it down; having scattered it upon the lower pressing stone, with: 'Desirous are you, divine Soma', he adds one of the adābhya shoots at each pressing, and with: 'What name of yours, O Soma, is undeceived, watchful', two of the upāṃśusavana shoots each.

8.3.8.o.s: tān upare nyupya vasatīvarībhir upasṛjya dakṣiṇaiḥ pāṇibhir grāvabhir yathārtham abhiṣutya nigrābham upayanti yathā purastāt /
8.3.8.o.d: तान् उपरे न्युप्य वसतीवरीभिर् उपसृज्य दक्षिणैः पाणिभिर् ग्रावभिर् यथार्थम् अभिषुत्य निग्राभम् उपयन्ति यथा पुरस्तात् ।
8.3.8.o.m: Having scattered them upon the lower pressing stone, having moistened them with the vasatīvarī waters, having pressed as appropriate with the stones held in their right hands, they perform the nigrābha as before.

8.3.8.p.m: In this manner the second and third pressings are prescribed.

8.3.8.q.m: They pour the thrice-pressed King [Soma] into the ādhavanīya vessel.

8.3.8.r.s: evaṃ vihito dvitīyas tṛtīyaś ca paryāyaḥ /
8.3.8.r.d: एवं विहितो द्वितीयस् तृतीयश् च पर्यायः ।
8.3.8.r.m: In this manner the second and third rounds are prescribed.

8.3.8.s.s: uttame 'bhiṣave susaṃbhṛtam̐ rājānaṃ kṛtvā pavitreṇa prapīḍyopare grāvṇaḥ saṃmukhān kṛtvā tebhya ṛjīṣaṃ vyapohati /
8.3.8.s.d: उत्तमे ऽभिषवे सुसंभृतम्̐ राजानं कृत्वा पवित्रेण प्रपीड्योपरे ग्राव्णः संमुखान् कृत्वा तेभ्य ऋजीषं व्यपोहति ।
8.3.8.s.m: At the final pressing, having well collected King [Soma], having squeezed it through the strainer, having placed the pressing stones face to face upon the lower pressing stone, he clears the soma residue from them.

8.3.8.u.m: The udgātṛs place the droṇakalaśa trough facing east upon the pressing stones.

8.3.9.a.s: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate \ prabhur gātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ / \ ataptatanūr na tad āmo aśnute \ śṛtāsa id vahantas tat samāśata \\ iti tasminn udīcīnadaśaṃ pavitram udgātāro vitatya dhārayanti /
8.3.9.a.d: पवित्रं ते विततं ब्रह्मणस्पते \ प्रभुर् गात्राणि पर्येषि विश्वतः । \ अतप्ततनूर् न तद् आमो अश्नुते \ शृतास इद् वहन्तस् तत् समाशत \\ इति तस्मिन्न् उदीचीनदशं पवित्रम् उद्गातारो वितत्य धारयन्ति ।
8.3.9.a.m: With: 'Your strainer is stretched out, O Brahmaṇaspati; powerful, you encompass the limbs from every side; one whose body is unheated, raw, does not attain it; only the matured, bearing it, have fully attained it', the udgātṛs hold the strainer stretched out in it with its fringe pointing north.

8.3.9.b.m: With this very [verse] the adhvaryu consecrates it.

8.3.9.d.m: And with the hotṛ's cup, he causes a continuous stream to flow into it.

8.3.9.e.m: With a ladle the unnetṛ brings [soma] from the ādhavanīya vessel into the hotṛ's cup.

8.3.9.f.m: From the flowing stream he draws the cups.

8.3.9.g.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ अन्तर् यच्छ \\ इत्य् अन्तर्यामम् ।
8.3.9.g.m: He draws the antaryāma cup with: 'You are taken with a base; hold within!'

8.3.9.h.m: Its procedure is explained by [that of] the upāṃśu cup.

8.3.9.i.s: dakṣiṇena hotāram atikramya vāk tvāṣṭu \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavatiṣṭhate dakṣiṇaṃ paridhisaṃdhim anvavahṛtya svāhā tvā subhavaḥ sūryāya \\ iti prāñcam udañcam ṛjuṃ dīrtham̐ saṃtataṃ juhoti /
8.3.9.i.d: दक्षिणेन होतारम् अतिक्रम्य वाक् त्वाष्टु \\ इति दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववतिष्ठते दक्षिणं परिधिसंधिम् अन्ववहृत्य स्वाहा त्वा सुभवः सूर्याय \\ इति प्राञ्चम् उदञ्चम् ऋजुं दीर्थम्̐ संततं जुहोति ।
8.3.9.i.m: Having stepped past the hotṛ to the south, he stands along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks with: 'May speech fashion you!'; having brought it down along the southern junction of the enclosing sticks, he offers it in a continuous, straight, long stream directed east and north, with: 'Hail to you, good-natured one, for Sūrya!'

8.3.9.j.s: na paridhau lepaṃ nimārṣṭi nāgrayaṇasthālyām̐ saṃpātam avanayati /
8.3.9.j.d: न परिधौ लेपं निमार्ष्टि नाग्रयणस्थाल्याम्̐ संपातम् अवनयति ।
8.3.9.j.m: He does not wipe off the residue on an enclosing stick, nor does he pour the residue into the āgrayaṇa vessel.

8.3.9.k.s: eṣa te yonir \ apānāya tvā \\ iti pātram̐ sādayati /
8.3.9.k.d: एष ते योनिर् \ अपानाय त्वा \\ इति पात्रम्̐ सादयति ।
8.3.9.k.m: He deposits the cup with: 'This is your womb; for down-breath, you!'

8.3.9.m.s: te antareṇa vyānāya tvā \\ ity upām̐śusavanaṃ grāvāṇam̐ sam̐spṛṣṭam upām̐śupātreṇa sādayati /
8.3.9.m.d: ते अन्तरेण व्यानाय त्वा \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शुसवनं ग्रावाणम्̐ सम्̐स्पृष्टम् उपाम्̐शुपात्रेण सादयति ।
8.3.9.m.m: Between them he deposits the upāṃśusavana stone touching the upāṃśu cup, with: 'For diffused breath, you!'

8.3.9.n.s: yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād ity asam̐spṛṣṭau tasya sādayed yaṃ kāmayeta sarvam āyur iyād iti sam̐spṛṣṭau tasya sādayet /
8.3.9.n.d: यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इत्य् असम्̐स्पृष्टौ तस्य सादयेद् यं कामयेत सर्वम् आयुर् इयाद् इति सम्̐स्पृष्टौ तस्य सादयेत् ।
8.3.9.n.m: For one whom he wishes should die prematurely, he should deposit the two not touching; for one whom he wishes should live a full lifespan, he should deposit the two touching.

8.3.9.o.m: Not hurrying, he offers both after [the sun] has risen.

8.3.9.p.d: त्वरमाणस् त्व् अनुदित उपांशुम् उदिते ऽन्तर्यामम् ।
8.3.9.p.m: Hurrying, however, [he offers] the upāṃśu before sunrise [and] the antaryāma after sunrise.

8.4.10.a.m: At a sacrifice having the Rathaṃtara-sāman, he should draw the cups beginning with the aindravāyava.

8.4.10.c.m: At one having both sāmans, as he pleases.

8.4.10.d.m: He should draw the aindravāyava cups at a modified combination of pṛṣṭha stotras.

8.4.10.e.m: 'One who has eldest brothers should draw those beginning with the aindravāyava'—[such are] optional [rules] in the regular [rite].

8.4.10.f.s: aindravāyavāgrān gṛhṇīyād āmayāvina iti brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni grahaṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī /
8.4.10.f.d: ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रान् गृह्णीयाद् आमयाविन इति ब्राह्मणव्याख्यातानि काम्यानि ग्रहणानि तेषां याथाकामी ।
8.4.10.f.m: 'One who is diseased should draw those beginning with the aindravāyava'—the optional drawings are explained by the Brāhmaṇa; among them [he acts] as he pleases.

8.4.10.g.m: They are drawn before the aindravāyava cup; when it is deposited, they are deposited.

8.4.10.i.s: ā vāyo bhūṣa \\ ity anudrutya pātram upayacchati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \ vāyave tvā \\ iti tasmin gṛhṇāti /
8.4.10.i.d: आ वायो भूष \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य पात्रम् उपयच्छति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \ वायवे त्वा \\ इति तस्मिन् गृह्णाति ।
8.4.10.i.m: Having recited: 'Come, O Vāyu, adorn...', he holds the cup under; he draws into it with: 'You are taken with a base; for Vāyu, you!'

8.4.10.j.s: pātram apayamya \\ indravāyū ity anudrutya punar evopayacchati \\ upayāmagṛhīto 'si \\ indravāyubhyāṃ tvā \\ iti tasmin punar gṛhṇāti /
8.4.10.j.d: पात्रम् अपयम्य \\ इन्द्रवायू इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य पुनर् एवोपयच्छति \\ उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि \\ इन्द्रवायुभ्यां त्वा \\ इति तस्मिन् पुनर् गृह्णाति ।
8.4.10.j.m: Having moved the cup away, having recited: 'O Indra and Vāyu...', he again holds it under; he draws into it again with: 'You are taken with a base; for Indra and Vāyu, you!'

8.4.10.k.s: yad avyāpṛtaṃ pavitraṃ tena parimṛjya \\ eṣa te yoniḥ \ sajoṣābhyāṃ tvā \\ ity āyatane sādayati /
8.4.10.k.d: यद् अव्यापृतं पवित्रं तेन परिमृज्य \\ एष ते योनिः \ सजोषाभ्यां त्वा \\ इत्य् आयतने सादयति ।
8.4.10.k.m: Having wiped it with the strainer that is not in use, he deposits it in its place with: 'This is your womb; for the two closely associated ones, you!'

8.4.10.l.m: Those with the upayāma formula at the beginning are drawn with a Yajus; those with the upayāma formula at the end are drawn with a Ṛc.

8.4.10.m.m: For all cups, there is wiping clean and placing in their respective places.

8.4.10.n.s: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā \\ iti maitrāvaruṇam \\ rāyā vayam̐ sasavām̐so madema \ havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ / \ tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ nas \\ viśvāhā dhattam anapasphurantīm iti tam̐ śṛtaśītena payasā śrītvā sādayati /
8.4.10.n.d: अयं वां मित्रावरुणा \\ इति मैत्रावरुणम् \\ राया वयम्̐ ससवाम्̐सो मदेम \ हव्येन देवा यवसेन गावः । \ तां धेनुं मित्रावरुणा युवं नस् \\ विश्वाहा धत्तम् अनपस्फुरन्तीम् इति तम्̐ शृतशीतेन पयसा श्रीत्वा सादयति ।
8.4.10.n.m: With the mantra: “This is for you both, O Mitra and Varuṇa…”, he draws the cup for Mitra and Varuṇa. Having mixed it with boiled milk that has cooled down, with the verse: “May we rejoice, having won wealth; may the gods rejoice with the oblation, the cattle with grass; O Mitra and Varuṇa, bestow upon us that cow, giving milk every day, unresisting”, he sets it down.

8.4.10.o.s: ayaṃ venas \\ iti śukram̐ hiraṇyena śrīṇāti /
8.4.10.o.d: अयं वेनस् \\ इति शुक्रम्̐ हिरण्येन श्रीणाति ।
8.4.10.o.m: With: “This longing bird…”, he mixes the Śukra cup with gold.

8.4.10.p.m: With: “Him in the ancient manner…”, he draws the Manthin cup.

8.4.10.q.s: mano na yeṣu havaneṣu juhvat \\ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā / \ ā yaḥ śaryābhis tuvinṛmṇo asya \\ aśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastau \\ iti saktubhir manthinam̐ śrīṇāty ātmānam anabhidhvam̐sayann itarām̐ś ca grahān /
8.4.10.q.d: मनो न येषु हवनेषु जुह्वत् \\ विपः शच्या वनुथो द्रवन्ता । \ आ यः शर्याभिस् तुविनृम्णो अस्य \\ अश्रीणीतादिशं गभस्तौ \\ इति सक्तुभिर् मन्थिनम्̐ श्रीणात्य् आत्मानम् अनभिध्वम्̐सयन्न् इतराम्̐श् च ग्रहान् ।
8.4.10.q.m: With: “Mind-like, when offering at those invocations, you two, running, win wisdom by your skill; he who, of great might, mixed his arrow with reed shafts in his hand…”, he mixes the Manthin cup with barley meal, without scattering it upon himself and the other cups.

8.4.10.r.s: ye devā divy ekādaśa stha \\ iti sthālyāgrayaṇam āgrayaṇo 'si \\ iti vā purastādupayāmena yajuṣā /
8.4.10.r.d: ये देवा दिव्य् एकादश स्थ \\ इति स्थाल्याग्रयणम् आग्रयणो ऽसि \\ इति वा पुरस्तादुपयामेन यजुषा ।
8.4.10.r.m: With the verse: “O gods who are eleven in the sky…”, using a pot, he draws the Āgrayaṇa cup; or with the Yajus having the upayāma at the beginning: “You are the Āgrayaṇa…”.

8.4.10.s.m: He draws it in two continuous streams.

8.4.10.t.s: ya āgrayaṇasthālyām̐ somas tasyaikadeśam anyasmin pātre niṣicya dvitīyāṃ dhārāṃ karoti /
8.4.10.t.d: य आग्रयणस्थाल्याम्̐ सोमस् तस्यैकदेशम् अन्यस्मिन् पात्रे निषिच्य द्वितीयां धारां करोति ।
8.4.10.t.m: Having poured a portion of the soma that is in the Āgrayaṇa pot into another vessel, he makes the second stream.

8.4.10.u.s: vidad yatī saramā rugṇam adres \\ mahi pāthaḥ pūrvyam̐ sadhriyak kaḥ / \ agraṃ nayat supady akṣarāṇām \ acchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt \\ iti purorucam abhicarataḥ kuryāt /
8.4.10.u.d: विदद् यती सरमा रुग्णम् अद्रेस् \\ महि पाथः पूर्व्यम्̐ सध्रियक् कः । \ अग्रं नयत् सुपद्य् अक्षराणाम् \ अच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गात् \\ इति पुरोरुचम् अभिचरतः कुर्यात् ।
8.4.10.u.m: For one who is practicing sorcery, he should use the puroruc: “Finding the broken [opening] of the rock, Saramā going forward made great food united from of old; fleet of foot, first knowing, she went toward the roar to lead the front of the syllables”.

8.4.10.v.m: For one who has a rival: “And the thirty-three…”.

8.4.10.w.s: āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhītvā him iti trir hiṃkaroti śanair agre 'thoccair atha sūccaiḥ somaḥ pavate \\ iti trir āha śanair agre 'thoccair atha sūccaiḥ //
8.4.10.w.d: आग्रयणं गृहीत्वा हिम् इति त्रिर् हिंकरोति शनैर् अग्रे ऽथोच्चैर् अथ सूच्चैः सोमः पवते \\ इति त्रिर् आह शनैर् अग्रे ऽथोच्चैर् अथ सूच्चैः ॥
8.4.10.w.m: Having drawn the Āgrayaṇa cup, he makes the sound “him” thrice: softly at first, then loudly, then very loudly. Thrice he says: “The soma purifies itself”: softly at first, then loudly, then very loudly.

8.4.11.a.s: asmai brahmaṇe pavate \\ asmai kṣatrāya pavate \\ asmai sunvate yajamānāya pavate \\ iṣa ūrje pavate \\ dbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate \ vanaspatibhyaḥ pavate \ dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate \ subhūtāya pavate \ brahmavarcasāya pavate \ yajamānāya pavate \ mahyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyāya pavate \\ iti somam abhimantrya vācaṃ visṛjate /
